postings.title: 3rd Shift - Manufacturing Engineer - Engine Assembly
postings.location: Lynn, Massachusetts, United States of America
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
As Engine Assembly Manufacturing Engineer, you will provide on-shift manufacturing engineering support for engine assembly operations during 3rd shift, helping production teams safely build engines to quality, delivery, and cost targets. You will work directly with assemblers, technicians, quality, and support teams to resolve shop-floor issues, maintain process control, troubleshoot technical and hardware-related problems, and ensure work is performed to engineering and process requirements. You will support ongoing production by responding to disruptions, clarifying technical instructions, interpreting drawings and specifications, and making decisions within established procedures to keep assembly flowing.

This role is responsible for monitoring assembly processes, identifying and preventing defects or escapes, supporting root cause investigation and corrective actions, and driving practical process improvements that improve safety, quality, and productivity. The engineer must be able to balance immediate production needs with longer-term process discipline, communicate clearly across functions, and escalate issues that fall outside standard limits. On 3rd shift, this often means serving as a key technical resource for the operation with greater independence and ownership in real-time problem solving.

Job Description

Shift / Schedule Expectations

- This position supports 3rd shift operations
- Typical hours are 10:30 pm-7:30 am
- Regular onsite support is required during assigned shift
- May require overtime, weekend support, or schedule flexibility based on production needs
- Requires effective communication with 1st and 2nd shift teams to support shift handoff and issue continuity

Roles and Responsibilities

- Provide daily manufacturing engineering support for engine assembly operations on 3rd shift
- Support assembly processes by resolving technical issues, process constraints, tooling issues, nonconformances, and build interruptions
- Work directly with assembly technicians and operators on the shop floor to troubleshoot problems and implement practical solutions
- Interpret and apply engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, process sheets, torque requirements, fits/clearances, and assembly sequencing requirements
- Develop, revise, and improve manufacturing processes, standard work, tooling, and production documentation
- Drive improvements in safety, quality, delivery, and cost
- Lead or support root cause investigations, corrective actions, and escape prevention related to assembly defects or process variation
- Partner with quality and operations to ensure compliance with engine assembly requirements, inspection requirements, and controlled process standards
- Support implementation of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives such as waste reduction, cycle time improvement, process simplification, and error-proofing
- Evaluate manufacturability and process risks and escalate issues when product or process integrity may be impacted
- Support new product introduction, process changes, tool changes, and production readiness activities as needed
- Communicate clearly across shifts and functions to ensure continuity of operations and effective issue resolution
- Use sound judgment to make timely decisions within established engineering and quality requirements, while escalating higher-risk issues appropriately

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Manufacturing, Mechanical, Aerospace, or related technical field (OR High school diploma / GED with at least 4 years of relevant experience in manufacturing, mechanical assembly, aircraft maintenance, engine assembly, engine overhaul/repair, aerospace production, or other closely related technical field)

Desired Characteristics

- Strong working knowledge of:
- Blueprint reading and engineering drawing interpretation
- GD&T
- Tooling, fixtures, torque tools, precision measurement, and mechanical assembly methods
- Process control and configuration control
- Root cause problem solving and corrective action
- Quality requirements, defect prevention, and escape prevention
- Standard work and lean manufacturing principles

- Experience with nonconformance disposition support, inspection findings, rework processes, and deviation management
- Familiarity with manufacturing documentation, routers, work instructions, process sheets, and revision-controlled technical data
- Experience collaborating with shop operations, quality, and design engineering to resolve build issues
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced production environment and make decisions with urgency and discipline
- Strong communication skills and ability to work respectfully with technicians, mechanics, and cross-functional teams

- Hands-on, practical mindset with strong shop-floor engagement
- Able to connect engineering requirements to real-world assembly execution
- Strong mechanical aptitude and product knowledge
- Effective at troubleshooting and resolving problems under production pressure
- Respectful, collaborative, and willing to learn from experienced technicians and operators
- Clear communicator who shares information across teams and shifts
- Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on safety, quality, and delivery
- High integrity, sound judgment, and disciplined decision-making in a regulated aerospace environment

The base pay range for this position is $92,000-$105,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 1, 2026.

postings.location: Bielsko-Biala, Silesian, Poland
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
Avio Aero, a GE Aerospace company, is a leading player in the aeronautics sector, specializing in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of components and propulsion systems for civil and military aircraft engines.

In this role you will be responsible for accounting, statutory and group reporting as well as taxes for two Polish GE Aerospace entities: Avio Polska and Polonia Aero. This position is suited for someone who enjoys collaborating with multiple teams in an international environment, has strong technical expertise, understands best practices and recognizes the impact of their area on the performance of the entire organization.

Job Description

Key responsibilities:

- Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including close cooperation with Shared Service Center (SSC) teams (e.g. accounts payable, cash and payments, intercompany, fixed assets, inventory).
- Supervise tax compliance and reporting, including ongoing cooperation with tax authorities, Group headquarters and external advisors. Act as a people leader for the tax specialist.
- Actively participate in preparing transfer pricing documentation and closely cooperate with Group headquarters and external tax advisors.
- Ensure timely and accurate preparation of all mandatory reports and financial statements required under Polish regulations.
- Prepare group reporting packages in accordance with IFRS, including reconciliation and postings of differences between statutory books and group reporting (bridge).
- Coordinate and support external and internal audits.
- Actively participate in monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing processes.
- Support the process of obtaining and settling government grants.
- Drive continuous improvement of accounting and tax processes as well as internal controls, with a strong focus on achieving full technical harmonization and aligning local processes with Avio Aero and GE Aerospace standards.
- Provide technical guidance and mentoring to less experienced team members.

Qualifications:

- University degree in accounting, finance or a related field; Polish Statutory Auditor title or ACCA qualification would be a strong plus.
- Professional experience gained in finance functions of companies operating in an international environment and/or in Big 4 audit firms.
- Excellent command of Polish and English.
- In-depth knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Polish Accounting Standards (PAS); familiarity with US GAAP would be an advantage.
- Proven experience in preparing statutory financial statements and group reporting packages.
- Solid understanding of tax regulations, including transfer pricing rules.
- Strong interpersonal skills and experience in building and maintaining relationships in a complex international environment.
- Ability to set priorities and deliver results within deadlines.
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
- Experience working with ERP systems, preferably SAP.
- EU work permit.

We offer

- Flexible work schedule and hybrid work model

- Co-financing sport activities

- Private medical care

- Discretionary awards

- Jubilee awards

- Holiday bonus

- Christmas bonus

- Annual bonus

- Santa Claus vouchers for employees' children

- Subsidizing summer camps / winter camps / green schools for employees' children

- Cash rewards under the employee suggestion system

- Generali group insurance - the basic variant of life insurance and accident insurance fully financed by the employer with the option of insuring family members

postings.description:
Job Description Summary
As an Advanced Lead Engineer – Commercial Field Service, you will get the unique opportunity to serve as the primary on-site representative for our customer and a single point of contact for key internal stakeholders before, during, and after aircraft entry into service.

Job Description

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

Our FSEs embody our mission, embedded within the customers site, delivering exceptional service and support. Operating autonomously and remotely from GE Aerospace hubs to resolve technical challenges and drive success, directly in support of our customers’ fleets. More specifically, you will:

- Provide Leadership and Technical Support: Offer technical direction and assistance to the customers operation, inspections, maintenance, and repair of assigned fleets.​
- Customer Advocacy: Deliver prompt, effective solutions that address customer issues and exceed their expectations, driving loyalty and long-term partnerships.
- Monitor and Improve Reliability: Track reliability and on-wing performance, including significant events, engine removals, delays, and cancellations. Influence airline stakeholders to implement critical reliability improvements.
- Enhance Maintenance Planning: Influence maintenance planning to ensure the stability of the aircraft engine fleet.​
- Evaluate Maintenance Effectiveness: Review the effectiveness of maintenance actions to identify opportunities for improvement.​
- Apply FLIGHT DECK: Utilize our FLIGHT DECK principles to deliver continuous improvement, identifying proactive reliability enhancements.
- Data Analytics and Reporting: Produce data analytics and timely reports on fleet status, program updates, events, and trends for key internal stakeholders.​
- Proactive Maintenance Recommendations: Provide recommendations for proactive maintenance based on engine performance analytics.​

Required Qualifications:

To be considered for this opportunity, candidates must have:

- A Bachelor of Engineering or technical degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED / technical certificate with at least 6 years of full-time work experience in airline operations or maintenance planning, engineering, aviation propulsion, or other related field

- A minimum of 4 years of full-time working experience in airline operations or maintenance planning, engineering, aviation propulsion, or other related field

Desired Characteristics:

- Technical expertise in aircraft engine or turbomachinery equipment
- Experience using software or data analytics to make informed technical decisions and to provide recommendations to the customer or other key internal stakeholders
- Self-directed with the ability to problem solve using sound judgement and critical thinking

- Ability to lead and deliver on result orientated priorities using strong project management, analytical, time management and prioritization skills
- Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to forge deep relations at all levels, not only with key internal stakeholders but also with the customer

- Passion to gain a deeper understanding of the commercial function and driving success for Aerospace with internal/external stakeholders, our customers, partners and colleagues

- Embody the GE Leadership Behaviors:

- - Respect for People: As an FSE, you’ll foster a collaborative environment with our customers, building strong relationships and trust. You’ll be the technical on-site representative for GE Aerospace.
- Continuous Improvement: We’re committed to excellence and constantly seek ways to enhance and improve technical performance.
- Customer Driven: Understanding, prioritizing, and communicating the needs of our customers is at the heart of our field service team. Delivering prompt, effective solutions that exceed customer expectations, driving long-term partnerships.​

Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!

Job Description Summary
Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!

As the Rotating Parts Commodity Focal, you will serve as a technical leader within the RTPE organization, providing expertise in design & analysis processes, mentoring engineers, and fostering collaboration across global teams. The position integrates best practices within the commodity, coordinates with internal and external stakeholders, and leads strategic and tactical efforts that span components. Responsibilities include engineering execution, project leadership, and MRB (Material Review Board) duties, ensuring adherence to business standards and delivering high-quality technical solutions.

Our organization, Rotorcraft Turboshaft & Turboprop Engineering (RTPE), focuses on Systems & Design Engineering for CT7, T700, T408, T64, and T58 engine families, supporting the helicopter business across commercial and military platforms worldwide, including, but not limited to, Black Hawk, CH-53E/K, Apache, CN-235, and Marine One. These programs provide critical products, services, and technical support for essential missions, such as defense, firefighting, emergency relief, search & rescue and more. RTPE offers a dynamic environment with a mix of production, manufacturing, and new product introduction, making it an exciting place to work on legacy and advanced helicopter engines.

Come and elevate your career in a facility that combines a rich tradition of aviation technology with a deep commitment to the future of flight. The GE Aerospace manufacturing site in Lynn designs, produces, assembles, and tests military and commercial aircraft engines and components. With 1.6 million sqft of manufacturing space, we’re making a huge contribution to the future of flight. And, considering that very first jet engines were born here in 1942, we clearly are the career home of people who are deeply knowledgeable about building quality engines. What’s more, GE Aerospace has invested more than $100 million in our facility in the last five years alone.

The Advanced Lead Engineer within our Advanced measurement technologies team will be responsible for designing and deploying novel mechanical integration applications using IR camera thermography for GE’s future of flight tests. You will be working closely with engineers, interns and laboratory personnel to ensure on-time customer delivery of projects. You will also lead the creation and execution of roadmaps and design practices for IR technology maturation as you help to develop the future of engine and component testing.

- This role requires the candidate to have the ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Security Clearance; prerequisite for a security clearance is U.S. Citizenship.

postings.title: Advanced Manufacturing Apprenticeship, Dowty 2027 intake
postings.location: Gloucester, Gloucestershire, United Kingdom
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
As an Advanced Manufacturing Apprentice you will work within multiple engineering disciplines, putting propeller design ideas into manufacture. Your new skills will enable you to manufacture propellers for large aircraft, including the C130J Hercules. You will study full time for the first year at GET – Gloucestershire Engineering Training. Participants graduate with a Level 3 Certificate recognised by relevant Professional Engineering Institutions at the appropriate level of professional registration (EngTech).

Job Description

About GE Aerospace

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

Dowty, a GE Aerospace company is based in Gloucestershire. It is a world-leading supplier of electronically controlled, composite propeller systems for a wide range of civil and military applications, including commercial airliners and military airlifters to multi-role seaplanes and marine hovercraft.

Key programs include the Lockheed Martin C-130J, the De Havilland Dash 8-400 and the Leonardo C-27J.

Dowty’s’ in-house production expertise for composite blades includes application of resin transfer moulding processes, which have been continuously evolved and perfected since 1976, and the use of braiding machines that rapidly and accurately apply the blades’ fibre outer layers.

Role Description

In addition to technical development, we are also committed to supporting your broader personal development. Throughout your time on the course, you will be given the opportunity to participate in projects and training outside of your apprenticeships with the aim of enhancing both your interpersonal and intrapersonal skills.

You will be supported by your line manager, plus placement managers, mentors, and the wider apprentice network, to ensure you are meeting the requirements of your course and getting the most out of your apprenticeship.

Overview of the scheme

Length of Program: 3 years plus End Point Assessment. You will receive a Level 3 Engineering and Manufacturing support technician qualification. The first year is full time at college with GET Engineering Training. In the second year you will be at college one day per week, with the remainder spent in the workplace. Third year is fulltime in the workplace, with time allocated for you to complete your EPA and any other required assignments.

As you progress through the years you will become a more integrated member of the team, taking on more responsibilities in your department and within the apprenticeship community.

Apprentices who have been through this program have successfully secured other roles, such as a Manufacturing Engineer.

Qualifications/Requirements

Please ensure you have achieved or are predicted these grades or above as these are the minimum requirements to join this apprenticeship. Failure to meet these grades could mean you are not eligible to join the programme.

Essential

A successful candidate would have, or be expected to achieve by the start of the apprenticeship:

- Achieved or predicted 4 GCSEs at Grade C/4 or equivalent, including Mathematics, English and a Science.

Desired Characteristics

- Able to roll up your sleeves and get involved in projects

- Organised & able to work towards deadlines

- Inspired and curious to learn

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Able to take ownership for projects

- Analytical and problem-solving skills

- Proficient in Microsoft Office

- Able to work as part of a team

Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process, you will be required to submit an initial CV application. After this, the stages include a video interview and assessment centre. Our recruitment team will be in touch with you at every stage to keep you updated and understand what is next in the process.

If you require any adjustments to the process to enable you to be at your best, please email the team via Apprenticeship.Queries@geaerospace.com.

Please only submit one application. If you submit multiple applications, we will progress the most suitable one. If in future you are deemed to be suitable for other opportunities, we will automatically consider you for these too.

Please note our applications will close on Sunday 1st November but may close earlier dependant on application volumes. We would encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Total Reward

At GE Aerospace we understand the importance of Total Reward. Our flexible benefits plan, called FlexChoice, gives you freedom, choice, and flexibility in the way you receive your benefits, as well as giving you the opportunity to make savings where possible.

As a new joiner to GE, we are pleased to be able to offer you the following as default in your benefit fund, which you then can tailor to meet your individual needs.

- Non-contributory Pension

- Life Assurance

- Group income protection

- Private medical cover

- Holiday Hourly equivalent of 26 days, with flexible option to buy or sell

Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance is required and must be maintained for this role. Please note that in the event that BPSS clearance cannot be obtained, you may not be eligible for the role and/or any offer of employment may be withdrawn on grounds of national security. Please see the link below for further details regarding the requirements for BPSS clearance: BPSS

postings.description:
Job Description Summary
GE Aerospace is seeking an experienced Advanced Staff Engineer – Power Electronics to provide technical leadership for advanced electrical power-conversion technologies and products. This role will lead complex engineering efforts supporting aerospace power generation, conversion, control, and energy-storage applications.

The successful candidate will combine deep power-electronics expertise with strong program execution, customer engagement, and cross-functional leadership skills. They will help shape technology roadmaps, develop innovative solutions, and guide technical teams through product and technology development.

Job Description

The Advanced Staff Engineer – Power Electronics will lead the design, analysis, development, and technical maturation of high-performance power-electronics systems. This includes power generation, power conversion, power-system analysis and controls, and energy-storage system integration.

Working across engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, customers, and other GE Aerospace organizations, this individual will provide technical direction, resolve complex program challenges, lead technical reviews, and ensure project requirements are met. The role requires strong expertise in power-conversion architectures, high-voltage/high-power hardware, controls, simulation, testing, and aerospace or military electrical standards.

Key Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership to cross-functional teams supporting power-electronics technology and product-development programs.
- Lead the design and development of power-conversion systems, including power generation, power conversion, power-system controls, and energy-storage integration.
- Develop detailed technical analyses and present findings, design decisions, risks, and recommendations during technical reviews.
- Serve as the customer-facing technical lead or Principal Investigator for assigned technology and development programs.
- Coordinate technology-development efforts with other GE Aerospace teams and ensure work aligns with long-term product and technology roadmaps.
- Develop and execute plans to meet technical program requirements, schedules, quality objectives, and customer commitments.
- Partner with suppliers, manufacturing, systems engineering, and other technical disciplines to deliver robust and producible solutions.
- Identify technical risks and issues, develop corrective-action plans, and drive resolution through closure.
- Support customer proposals by reviewing requirements, assessing technical feasibility, and identifying capability gaps.
- Maintain awareness of power-electronics technology trends, competitive products, and market differentiators.
- Mentor and coach engineers, including developing technical talent for Principal Investigator and engineering-lead roles.
- Support leadership with technical reviews of customer requirements and product capabilities.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited university or college.
- Minimum of 10 years of experience in power electronics engineering.
- Demonstrated experience designing, analyzing, developing, or supporting power-conversion hardware and systems.
- Experience leading technical workstreams, engineering projects, or cross-functional technical teams.
- Ability to communicate technical information clearly to engineering teams, leadership, suppliers, and customers.
- Must qualify as a U.S. person under applicable export-control regulations, including U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, and other protected individuals. Proof of status will be required before employment.

Desired Qualifications

- Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering.
- Experience with high-voltage, high-power converters or inverters, including systems of at least 10 kW and operating voltages above 270 V.
- Strong knowledge of DC-DC, DC-AC, and AC-DC power-conversion topologies and associated control methods.
- Experience with single-phase and three-phase electrical machines, including induction and synchronous machines in both motoring and generating modes.
- Knowledge of electromagnetic interference (EMI), including common-mode and differential-mode noise, and compliance with DO-160G and MIL-STD-461 requirements.
- Experience with transformer design, semiconductor switches, gate-driver design, PWM techniques, and power-stage layout.
- Experience with semiconductor loss modeling and validation testing, including double-pulse and pump-back testing.
- Familiarity with DSP-, microcontroller-, and FPGA-based control systems.
- Experience with circuit design and layout tools, such as Altium.
- Experience using simulation tools such as PLECS, LTspice, Simplorer, ANSYS/Ansoft, FEMM, MATLAB, or Simulink.
- Strong electrical circuit design, PCB layout, and hands-on laboratory testing experience.
- Experience supporting New Technology Introduction (NTI) and New Product Introduction (NPI) programs in power conversion.
- Strong influence, facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
- U.S. citizenship is preferred.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a senior-level power-electronics engineer who can lead both the technical solution and the people executing it. They have deep experience with high-voltage and high-power conversion hardware, understand power-system controls and electrical-machine interfaces, and can move confidently between simulation, design review, lab validation, manufacturing support, and customer discussions.

They are comfortable owning difficult technical problems, guiding engineering teams through trade studies and design decisions, and translating customer needs into practical, reliable product solutions. This person is a collaborative technical leader who can influence across organizational boundaries, mentor other engineers, and help shape the future power-electronics technology roadmap.

Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Aerospace Inspector

About GE Aerospace:

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

Working at our Beavercreek Site

GE Aerospace operations have been part of the Beavercreek community for over 75 years! Our Beavercreek facility on Research Blvd. manufactures gas turbine tubes, ducts, and manifolds, and also has complex machining, fabrication and investment casting capabilities. Product engineering, new product development and testing is performed on site. This facility also does repair and overhaul of tubes, ducts, and manifolds. Our location on Heller drive manufactures turbine airfoils and has a focus on next generation technology. We have been awarded OSHAS’s highest safety rating.

Role Overview – Inspector

This role is responsible for performing preliminary, in‑process, and final inspections on aerospace components in accordance with new engine manuals and FAA‑approved technical data. You will play a key role in ensuring airworthiness, quality, and on‑time delivery for critical engine components.

In this role, you will:

- Execute all manufacturing work with a rigorous focus on safety, quality, and the critical nature of aircraft parts.
- Perform preliminary, in‑process, and final inspections on engine and component parts
- Inspect parts for defects, dimensional accuracy, and compliance to engineering specifications and customer requirements
- You will heavily utilize a computer to navigate through different programs, blueprints, software, and Microsoft products
- Use hands and fingers to move parts, use measurement instruments, and manually examine parts
- Read and interpret OEM manuals, blueprints, and, where applicable, FAA‑approved technical data
- Complete inspection documentation, including Records of Measurement, certifications, and other required quality records
- Verify traceability and documentation for incoming, in‑process, and completed parts to ensure compliance and airworthiness
- Support production flow by working closely with operations, shipping, and other partners to meet on‑time delivery commitments
- Lift and exert 10–25 pounds of force frequently and 20–50 pounds of force occasionally, with or without reasonable accommodation
- Perform other inspection‑related duties as required to support safety, quality, and delivery (SQD)
- Cross‑train to work in all areas of the cell and run other processes as production needs require
- Train other team members on standard work and machine operation as needed
- In designated areas, comply with mandatory or random drug testing requirements
- Assist in other areas as needed and directed by People Leader

The Ideal Candidate

In this role, you’ll use your skills every day to help us deliver safe, high‑quality products on time, at the right cost:

- You show up reliably, your team counts on you
- You’re willing to learn multiple roles to support the team
- Maintain focus and discipline on the shop floor, avoiding distractions to ensure safe, high-quality, and on-time production.
- Follow all safety rules when using and maintaining shop equipment; pass and maintain required vision testing
- Use basic and shop math (fractions, decimals, whole numbers) to support accurate, precise work
- Read and apply technical information and blueprints to produce high‑quality parts
- Use standard measuring tools (manual calipers, micrometers) to verify dimensions and prevent defects
- Follow written, verbal, and visual instructions to complete work on time and support on‑time delivery
- Use tools and materials responsibly, help reduce scrap and rework, and raise issues early to support continuous improvement in safety, quality, delivery, and cost (SQD)

Required Qualifications

- High school diploma or General Education Degree (GED)
- At least 6 months of relevant experience in a production, manufacturing, quality, or aerospace environment where safety, precision, and standard work are critical.
- Experience using manual calipers to perform precise dimensional inspections in a manufacturing environment.
- Visual acuity sufficient to accurately read micrometers, manual calipers, and other precision measuring instruments, with or without reasonable accommodation
- Basic computer skills, including the ability to use Microsoft Office applications (such as Outlook and Word) and navigate work instructions or quality documentation systems
- This role may encounter high risk or hazardous operations and/or include working shifts beyond a standard workweek. As such, a requirement of the role is to be at least 18 years of age by the time of joining.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience accurately reading and interpreting technical documents such as blueprints, OEM/FAA technical data, customer specifications, quality standards, and manufacturing or inspection control plans
- Prior experience in an aerospace or regulated environment with strong focus on documentation, traceability, and compliance
- FAA Repairman Certificate/License, or eligibility/interest in obtaining one based on role requirements
- Team‑oriented, professional approach to working with peers and leaders
- Demonstrated pride in workmanship and commitment to quality
- Strong attendance and punctuality record, with availability to work overtime as needed
- Ability to make decisions based on approved work instructions, experience, and available data
- Drive to meet or exceed job requirements and performance expectations
- Ability to work effectively under general supervision, including performing routine assignments independently
- Ability to carry out operations according to set procedures or sequences (standard work)
- Willingness to receive and act on constructive feedback

Additional Information

- Wages: $22.75 – $26.00 per hour based on experience
- Additional 10%/hour premium for 2nd or 3rd shift
- Repairman License: Inspectors who obtain and actively maintain and use an FAA Repairman License in accordance with the minimum standards established for this role may qualify for an additional $3.50 per hour in compensation.
- Ability to lift up to 40 pounds; may occasionally lift up to 50 pounds (with assistance)
- Strong safety focus with daily and monthly reviews; site has been awarded OSHA’s highest safety rating
- Most protective gear provided, including hearing protection as needed; GE Aerospace provides a $125 voucher for safety shoes and a voucher for prescription safety glasses if needed
- Work in and around moving equipment such as stand‑up forklifts, mobile carts, and cranes; normal machining operations may generate dust, fumes, or smoke (not over OSHA permissible exposure levels)
- Team‑oriented environment with opportunities to share ideas and make recommendations with peers and leadership
- Work may involve standing in one place for extended periods, walking, and climbing stairs; most areas are climate‑controlled

Our Culture

We strive to keep a safe, high‑performing, and enjoyable shop atmosphere while maintaining the highest level of quality output. We work together to make the “impossible” happen and are looking for people like you to join us. If you’re a team‑oriented welder who takes pride in your work, shares ideas, and wants to grow your skills, we’d like to meet you.

Job Description Summary
Contribue à la continuité et l'efficacité de la réception, de l'expédition, des transferts inter-usine et de la gestion de l'entrepôt dans un objectif de livraison des produits et services aux clients internes. Réalise des tâches telles que les activités liées à la réception, l'entreposage, l'expédition, les retours de marchandises (manutention, etc.), le contrôle des opérations de chargement ou déchargement ainsi que de l'état de livraison des produits. L’utilisation d’un chariot élévateur, d’un système ERP, MES et suite Office 365 est essentiel.

Job Description

Quart de travail: lundi au vendredi 10h30 a 19h00

(formation: lundi au vendredi - jour)

Entrepôt Général BOI et STE

- Effectuer les réceptions et l’envoi des marchandises
- Placement et distribution des marchandises avec chariot élévateur lorsque requis et suivi des items Kanban
- Faire les transactions informatiques nécessaires pour la réception des marchandises (ERP), les items Kanban (ERP) et le les mouvements d’inventaire des matières premières (MES).
- Répondre aux courriels et appels téléphoniques des clients internes;
- Préparation de certains emballages pour l’expédition selon les besoins.

Entrepôt de Poudre STE

- Entreposer et déplacer les palettes de poudres à l’aide du chariot élévateur;
- Effectuer le déplacement et l’entreposage de certaines marchandises selon les besoins ponctuels de la production;
- Préparation des commandes des différents clients (production, recycleurs, destruction, distribution, inter-usine) et préparation des matières premières pour le SIMPA;
- Faire les transactions informatiques nécessaires pour le déplacement de l’inventaire (MES) et les commandes pour distribution (ATOMAS);
- Effectuer la logistique des barils de matières dangereuses résiduelles pour la production.

Transfert inter usine

- Effectuer les transferts inter-usine avec un camion cube – permis de classe 5 valide requis;
- Effectuer les transferts inter-usine des poudres considérées matières dangereuses – Permis RTMD (classe 2-9 sauf 7) – fourni par l’employeur;
- Effectuer le ramassage ou la livraison de certaines marchandises selon besoin.

Production

- Faire la logistique des palettes de cannes qui doivent être transférées au bunker à la suite de l’identification de la planification.

- 3 à 5 ans d’expérience de conduite d’un charriot élévateur debout et assis, habitué en espace restreint;
- Carte de conduite de chariot élévateur valide requise.

- Facilitates adoption of AI-enabled solutions within the company. Work closely with stakeholders to ensure seamless adoption, address any resistance or concerns, and promote a culture of innovation.

- Key Leader in Data Organization & Protection: Oversee data architecture, engineering, platforms, and governance, ensuring a robust, scalable, and secure data ecosystem.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with engineering, digital, product, and business leaders to embed AI and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

- Regulatory & Ethical AI Governance: Ensure AI solutions meet industry, regulatory, and ethical standards, particularly in aerospace and defense applications.

Qualification & Experience

- Data Management, Interpretation and Processing: Adept at organizing, analyzing, and transforming data to extract meaningful insights and support informed decision-making.

- Cloud Computing: Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure for deploying and scaling AI solutions.

- Business Acumen: Understands business operations, market dynamics, and financial principles to make strategic decisions.

- Operational Excellence: Executes business processes efficiently and effectively to achieve optimal business performance.

- Experienced in Programming Tech & Tools: Expertise in languages such as Python, R, and SQL.

- Strong Program Management & Organizational Skills: Spearhead all dimensions and layers within the organization to deliver on time, on budget solutions and deliverables.

- Team player who prioritizes customer solutions and business objectives and unyieldingly leverages FLIGHT DECK, our proprietary lean operating model.

- Multi-faceted data science expert—capable of operating at a strategic level while also being hands-on ("Go to Genba") to collaboratively solve problems.

- Embodies GE Aerospace’s ‘One Culture’ characteristics:

- Passionate Innovator – Drives AI and data-driven innovation to create new business opportunities.

- Developer of World-Class Talent – Builds and nurtures high-performing AI and data teams.

- Accountable Owner – Takes full ownership of initiatives with a focus on execution and results.

Job Description

Company Overview

GE Aerospace (NYSE: GE) is a global leader in aerospace propulsion, services, and integrated systems. Currently, it has approximately 44,000 in-service commercial aircraft engines worldwide. With a century-long history of innovation and profound industry expertise, GE Aerospace is committed to inventing the future of flight, lifting people up, and bringing them home safely.

For 45 years in China, GE Aerospace has committed to developing and investing in China’s aviation industry with reliable, efficient, sustainable, and outstanding products and services. Together with our partners, we are shaping a sustainable future of flight that helps the industry reach its carbon-neutral goal for the benefit of us all tomorrow.

Maintain CNC machine tools correctly. Continuously improve the machining process and process equipment of products to continuously increase production capacity.

- Perform parts processing work in accordance with established machining process documents and specifications.

- Under supervision, follow standard procedures and written operating instructions.

- Operate and maintain CNC machine tools correctly.

Required Qualifications

- Able to understand mechanical drawings.

- Have a certain level of English and be able to understand relevant English work documents.

Our Supply Chain organizations combine passionate people, cutting-edge technology, and a culture of continuous improvement to provide the highest quality products to our customers. - Support manufacturing processes for additive printer assembly, including assembly fixture/tooling design
- Maintain high-quality standards via risk assessment, root cause analysis, corrective action, including NC follow-up, assembly error-proofing, and closure of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) findings
- Ensure safe work conditions via Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) initiatives, including safe design and use of fixtures, tooling, and material handling methods
- Learn and apply Lean and Six Sigma principles to drive productivity, on-time delivery, process capability, and stable operations in our increasingly complex and demanding environment, including inventory and material handling strategy improvements
- Support delivery efforts for sourced components by working with suppliers while building project management skills and business acumen, including Key Performance Indicators (KPI) tracking to monitor performance and drive actions

Qualifications/Requirements

- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s of Master’s Degree program at an accredited university. Degrees focused on Mechanical, Electrical, Material Sciences, Computer Sciences or other relevant STEM majors.
- Minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA off a 4.0 scale without rounding.

Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen. Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this opening.

postings.title: Composites Lead Mechanical Design Engineer
postings.location: Evendale, Ohio, United States of America
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
The Cold Section Design organization is responsible for the design, analysis, integration, and support of future military engine products. In this role, the Lead Mechanical Design Engineer will own the design and development of advanced military engine components. Responsibilities include executing technical design tasks such as analysis, manufacturing support, and hardware testing, while also managing cost, weight, and schedule deliverables for assigned hardware.

This position reports to an Engineering Manager in Evendale, OH and offers the opportunity to collaborate with a variety of internal and external engineering disciplines.

Our Cold Section Design teams are passionate about aerospace and dedicated to supporting military customers. We are developing breakthrough technologies that will shape the future of military propulsion while continuing GE Aerospace’s long legacy of engineering excellence.

This role is 100% on-site/in-person.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Execute the design, analysis, and evaluation of composite components for advanced military products.
- Follow business standards, practices, procedures, and product requirements.
- Apply prior mechanical design experience and deepen expertise within the discipline to deliver products on schedule and within budget.
- Demonstrate systems thinking to understand how the team’s work integrates with other functions to meet product requirements.
- Make decisions within a defined requirements framework and resolve design challenges requiring technical judgment.
- Review designs and consult with senior technical leaders to evaluate work and drive sound outcomes.
- Build strong internal and external relationships by serving as an interface point across GE Aerospace teams.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical engineering or Aeronautical Engineering from an accredited university with a minimum of 2 years of professional experience
- Must have, or be able to obtain, a U.S. Government Security Clearance at the Secret level.

Desired Characteristics

- Highly motivated, passionate, and equipped with strong communication skills.
- Demonstrated ability to analyze and solve technical design challenges, with solid documentation, planning, and program management skills.
- Experience with finite element analysis software such as ANSYS and 3D modeling software such as NX Unigraphics.
- Experience manufacturing aerospace components.
- Experience with aerospace propulsion system testing.
- Existing U.S. Government Security Clearance.

postings.location: Newark, Delaware, United States of America
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
Are you passionate about cutting-edge manufacturing and eager to make an impact in the aerospace industry? We are seeking a Composites Machining Process Specialist to join our 2nd shift team and play a pivotal role in producing high-quality, compliant, and innovative products that define the future of flight. In this dynamic role, you will combine your expertise in composites machining, and process improvement to ensure operational excellence while contributing to the development of new processes and solutions.

Job Description

At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. As a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft, we are at the forefront of advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Joining GE Aerospace means bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team that values your ideas and listens to your voice. You will be part of our ongoing LEAN transformation, working smarter, not harder, and contributing to work that truly matters. Here, you will elevate your future, share in our pride and purpose, and make a real impact on the lives of millions around the globe. If you believe in the power of flight and want to be part of a spirited and collaborative team, come aboard and help us lead the way.

As a Composites Machining Process Specialist, you will:

Machining Operations:

- Build your expertise in composites machining processes by Operating and adjusting CNC equipment to machine intricate shapes and features with high precision
- Produce high‑precision ceramic matrix composite (CMC) parts for turbines, Aerospace, and rocket applications using equipment such as Makino machining centers and hand tools
- Conduct in-process quality inspections to ensure compliance with aerospace standards and specifications.
- Support and learn from more experienced machinists, while also helping less experienced teammates with basic setups and best practices.
- Gain the ability to read and interpret technical drawings and use precision measurement tools, basic understanding of GD&T
- Follow daily production plans, communicate status, and help ensure work is completed safely, on time, and to quality standards

Drive Process Excellence:

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Computerized Machine Operator (CMO)

About GE Aerospace:

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

Working at our Beavercreek Site

GE Aerospace operations have been part of the Beavercreek community for over 75 years! Our Beavercreek facility on Research Blvd. manufactures gas turbine tubes, ducts, and manifolds, and also has complex machining, fabrication and investment casting capabilities. Product engineering, new product development and testing is performed on site. This facility also does repair and overhaul of tubes, ducts, and manifolds. Our location on Heller drive manufactures turbine airfoils and has a focus on next generation technology. We have been awarded OSHAS’s highest safety rating.

Role Overview – Computerized Machine Operator

In this role, you will:

- Execute all manufacturing work with a rigorous focus on safety, quality, and the critical nature of aircraft parts.
- Set up, operate, edit, and program a variety of computerized machines (for example, furnaces, lasers, robots, Coherent General 8‑axis equipment, presses, and benders) to meet customer specifications and drawing requirements
- Test new tooling and dies, evaluate performance, and recommend modifications to improve quality and throughput
- Perform regular preventive maintenance and verify that tools, gauges, and equipment are accurately calibrated prior to use
- Operate machines in accordance with all safety rules, standard work, and documented procedures
- Cross‑train to work in all areas of the cell and run other processes as production needs require
- Train other team members on standard work and machine operation as needed
- Use a computer daily to check email and access/view/download shop drawings, work instructions, and setup/program files
- Assist in other areas as needed and directed by People Leader

The Ideal Candidate

In this role, you’ll use your skills every day to help us deliver safe, high‑quality products on time, at the right cost:

- You show up reliably, your team counts on you
- You’re willing to learn multiple roles to support the team
- Maintain focus and discipline on the shop floor, avoiding distractions to ensure safe, high-quality, and on-time production.
- Follow all safety rules when using and maintaining shop equipment; pass and maintain required vision testing

Required Qualifications

- Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force frequently and occasionally 20–50 pounds of force (with assistance as needed), with or without reasonable accommodation
- Ability to stand for up to 8 hours per day, with or without reasonable accommodation
- This role may encounter high risk or hazardous operations and/or include working shifts beyond a standard workweek. As such, a requirement of the role is to be at least 18 years of age by the time of joining.

Preferred Qualifications

- Basic understanding of, or strong willingness and ability to learn, the use of measuring gauges such as manual calipers and micrometers
- Ability to read and interpret blueprints, or interest in learning blueprint reading through on‑the‑job training
- Prior experience in a manufacturing environment following written instructions and standard work

- Team‑oriented, professional approach to working with peers and leaders
- Demonstrated pride in workmanship and commitment to quality
- Strong attendance and punctuality record, with availability to work overtime as needed
- Ability to make decisions based on approved work instructions, experience, and available data
- Drive to meet or exceed job requirements and performance expectations
- Ability to work effectively under general supervision, including performing routine assignments independently
- Ability to carry out operations according to set procedures or sequences (standard work)
- Willingness to receive and act on constructive feedback

Additional Information

- Additional 10%/hour premium for 2nd or 3rd shift

- Work in and around moving equipment such as stand‑up forklifts, mobile carts, and cranes; normal machining operations may generate dust, fumes, or smoke (not over OSHA permissible exposure levels)
- Team‑oriented environment with opportunities to share ideas and make recommendations with peers and leadership
- Work may involve standing in one place for extended periods, walking, and climbing stairs; most areas are climate‑controlled

Our Culture

We strive to keep a safe, high‑performing, and enjoyable shop atmosphere while maintaining the highest level of quality output. We work together to make the “impossible” happen and are looking for people like you to join us. If you’re a team‑oriented welder who takes pride in your work, shares ideas, and wants to grow your skills, we’d like to meet you.

Job Description Summary
The Cycle Count Operator at GE Aerospace in Clearwater performs teardown and counting of reels and trays using an X‑Ray Counter, scanning items and updating counted quantities into Mycenter. Responsibilities include scanning reels to teardown locations, returning baskets and magazines, accurately putting reels away into towers or racks, and executing finance/variance-driven cycle counts while recording and submitting physical count sheets to Noel for validation

Job Description

If you want to do work that really matters among a team of spirited and collaborative individuals, you need to know more about GE Aerospace. We’ve become a world leader in the design, development, and manufacture of advanced aviation technologies including jet engines, components and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We’re a people-first organization that will bring out your best ideas and performance as part of our on-going LEAN transformation. We believe that the world works better when it flies. Do you? If so, come aboard.

Working at our Clearwater Facilities

Clearwater is a provider of engineering, circuit card assembly, OEM Avionics and MRO services to commercial and military customers. Products and technologies here are diverse and highly sophisticated. Your work will contribute to systems that manage the performance of Boeing 737 and 787 aircraft as well as F-18s, F-35s and Harriers and Apaches. You’ll be part of a 400+ team that includes people from 25 distinct nationalities with fluency across 27 languages. We have been awarded OSHAS’s highest safety rating.

Essential Responsibilities:

Teardown & Count

- Removing the reels from feeders and scanning each reel to a teardown location
- Returning baskets and magazines to their proper location
- Count each reel as it comes from teardown using the X-Ray Counter and updating the counted quantities into Mycenter

Put Away

- Once each reel is counted, the reels must be returned into stock either into towers or racks by accurately scanning each reel to its proper location.

Cycle Counts

- Based on daily list driven by finance and variance count cycles, reels and trays must be retrieved from its location, brought to the x-ray counter, count the material, and update the count on a physical sheet and turn into Noel for count/inventory validation.

Requirements include

- High School Diploma or equivalent.
- This role may encounter high risk or hazardous operations and/or include working shifts beyond a standard workweek. As such, a requirement of the role is to be at least 18 years of age by the time of joining.

postings.title: Cycle Count Operator - 2nd shift
postings.location: Clearwater, Florida, United States of America
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
The Cycle Count Operator at GE Aerospace in Clearwater performs teardown and counting of reels and trays using an X‑Ray Counter, scanning items and updating counted quantities into Mycenter. Responsibilities include scanning reels to teardown locations, returning baskets and magazines, accurately putting reels away into towers or racks, and executing finance/variance-driven cycle counts while recording and submitting physical count sheets to Noel for validation

Job Description

If you want to do work that really matters among a team of spirited and collaborative individuals, you need to know more about GE Aerospace. We’ve become a world leader in the design, development, and manufacture of advanced aviation technologies including jet engines, components and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We’re a people-first organization that will bring out your best ideas and performance as part of our on-going LEAN transformation. We believe that the world works better when it flies. Do you? If so, come aboard.

Working at our Clearwater Facilities

Clearwater is a provider of engineering, circuit card assembly, OEM Avionics and MRO services to commercial and military customers. Products and technologies here are diverse and highly sophisticated. Your work will contribute to systems that manage the performance of Boeing 737 and 787 aircraft as well as F-18s, F-35s and Harriers and Apaches. You’ll be part of a 400+ team that includes people from 25 distinct nationalities with fluency across 27 languages. We have been awarded OSHAS’s highest safety rating.

Essential Responsibilities:

Teardown & Count

- Removing the reels from feeders and scanning each reel to a teardown location
- Returning baskets and magazines to their proper location
- Count each reel as it comes from teardown using the X-Ray Counter and updating the counted quantities into Mycenter

Put Away

- Once each reel is counted, the reels must be returned into stock either into towers or racks by accurately scanning each reel to its proper location.

Cycle Counts

- Based on daily list driven by finance and variance count cycles, reels and trays must be retrieved from its location, brought to the x-ray counter, count the material, and update the count on a physical sheet and turn into Noel for count/inventory validation.

Requirements include

- High School Diploma or equivalent.
- This role may encounter high risk or hazardous operations and/or include working shifts beyond a standard workweek. As such, a requirement of the role is to be at least 18 years of age by the time of joining.
- Ability to read and comprehend written work instructions which may be technical in nature.
- Ability to lift/move material up to 35 pounds.
- Ability to work overtime as required.

Desirable qualifications

- 3 to 5 years of industry or similarly related job experience.
- Prior experience working in a team-oriented environment.
- Prior experience with LEAN & Continuous Improvement.

Job Description Summary
As part of the GE India Multi-modal Manufacturing team, the Deputy Engineer- Quality inspector is responsible for establishing an efficient and continually improving DSQR process as per Spec 1182 and AS 9100 / ISO 9001 and internal GE QMS norms. Own & drive key Quality deliverables in the projects including analysis & certifying aviation hardware per internal quality inspection requirements .

Job Description

Site Overview:

Our Multi-modal Manufacturing Facility (MMF) in Pune plays a crucial role in manufacturing key aerospace components, supporting not only India’s defence and commercial sectors but also global aviation supply chains. Our relationships with Indian suppliers, combined with our world-class local facilities and global reach, continue to shape India’s aerospace ecosystem.

Role Overview:

- The position will report to the Quality Engineer / Manager.
- Responsible to carry out inspections in quality in DSQR for various customer GE, MRAS, collins.
- Work closely with manufacturing / production & Quality system teams to develop and implement AS 9100 procedures & systems & support driving end to end production quality flow downs.
- Willingness to work & get qualified to Cross functional teams & quality cells along with HPT teams for daily analysis of yield improvement , EHS & process improvisation projects.

- Knowledge on dimensional inspection methodologies.

- Providing training, and support to shop operations, design and manufacturing to assure effective Quality Assurance
- Maintaining awareness of the latest inspection techniques & processes and their beneficial and limiting aspects for optimum application
- Pursuing continuous improvement for quality & cost reductions projects.

Candidate would be responsible for Final inspection of the aerospace hardware. Aware about AS9100, FAI, NC, RCCA and QMS requirement

postings.description:
Job Description Summary
The Digital Tools Leader – International Trade Compliance is responsible for defining and advancing the digital strategy and technology-enabled capabilities that support the company’s ITC program. Reporting to the newly established Senior Director – Programs & Operations Leader, ITC, this role serves as the primary business partner between the ITC and Digital Technology organizations.
Partnering closely with the Digital Technology team, this leader will define the ITC digital roadmap, translate regulatory and operational needs into business requirements, and help ensure technology solutions enable effective execution, risk visibility, process standardization, and user experience across the enterprise.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

- Develop and maintain the ITC digital strategy and roadmap aligned with regulatory requirements, ITC priorities, and business needs.
- Serve as the primary interface between ITC and the Digital Technology organization for systems and tools supporting international trade compliance.
- Establish governance and prioritization mechanisms for ITC technology investments, enhancements, and system changes.
- Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and standardize ITC processes through digital enablement.
- Ensure effective governance of ITC tools and support implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement of ITC tools across the enterprise.
- Evaluate current technology gaps and develop recommendations for enhancements or new solutions.
- Partner with ITC leaders and process owners to ensure technology solutions support workflow execution, reporting, controls, and data visibility.
- Partner with the ITC Risk Management Leader to enable risk analytics, monitoring, dashboards, and reporting.
- Evaluate current technology gaps and develop recommendations for enhancements or new solutions.

Required Minimum Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 10 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of 12 years of professional experience

- Minimum 6 years of professional experience in digital product management, business system, compliance operations, or a related discipline.

- Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required

Desired Characteristics:

- Demonstrated experience translating complex business or regulatory requirements into technology-enabled solutions, with the ability to simplify complexity, define clear requirements, and drive practical outcomes.

- Experience partnering with Digital/IT organizations in a large, complex enterprise, building strong relationships, aligning priorities, and driving execution across organizational boundaries.

- Strong digital and enterprise mindset.
- Ability to connect regulatory requirements, business processes, data, and technology, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with business and compliance objectives.
- Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed environment.
- Strong prioritization, program management, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Skilled at translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders, creating clarity, building shared understanding, and enabling effective decision-making and adoption.

The base pay range for this position is $155,000 - $206,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on October 25th, 2026.

Job Description Summary
The Advanced Technology Organization (ATO) drives product development through early-stage innovation, new technology introduction (NTI), and New Product Introduction (NPI) across sensing, autonomy, artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML), product security, and advanced edge processing hardware. This DSE role works across a highly diverse technical team and partners closely with business-facing teams and product managers to translate advanced technologies into product strategies, development roadmaps, and scalable solutions aligned with market opportunities, customer needs, and product launch objectives.

As a Distinguished Staff Engineer, you will lead the architecture, development, and maturation of secure networking products with built-in security capabilities for real-world applications. You will collaborate across hardware, firmware, software, and systems teams to ensure security is designed into products from concept through deployment. In this role, you will help transition advanced technologies into scalable, certifiable, and deployable product solutions while influencing product security technical roadmaps across GE Aerospace programs.

Active U.S. Government Security Clearance.

Location: Grand Rapids, MI. This is a fully onsite position requiring attendance five days per week. A comprehensive corporate relocation package is available for eligible candidates.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

As a Distinguished Staff Engineer, you will:

- Lead the development and integration of advanced networking products and security technologies for GE Aerospace products and platforms.

- Apply secure-by-design principles across hardware, firmware, software, and system architectures for mission-critical networking applications.

- Partner with hardware, software, firmware, networking, and toolchain developers to identify, evaluate, and implement solutions for complex and secure networking product needs.

- Lead medium- to large-scale technical efforts, driving execution from concept definition through implementation and transition into production environments.

- Help mature innovative security and networking capabilities into product-ready solutions that can be deployed across GE Aerospace products.

- Contribute to technical strategy and roadmap definition for secure embedded and networked platforms, aligning innovation with business and product priorities.

- Guide the design and development of resilient system architectures, including vulnerability mitigation and security-focused design approaches.

- Support product security activities such as threat-informed design, attack surface reduction, vulnerability mitigation, and security architecture trade studies.

- Document technical approaches, design outcomes, and innovations through patent applications, technical reports, publications, and internal engineering deliverables.

- Stay current on emerging trends in networking, embedded cybersecurity, secure networking products, platform security, and secure system design, and apply that knowledge to new product opportunities.

- Collaborate across GE Aerospace businesses, engineering teams, and external stakeholders, including U.S. Government agencies.

- Shape and lead technical proposals and response strategies for internal business opportunities and external customers.

Qualifications / Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline with a minimum of 15 years of industry experience

- Active U.S. Government Security Clearance.

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in the design and development of embedded networked products, such as routers, switches, gateway devices, VPN devices, cable modems, or similar communications/edge platforms.

- Demonstrated experience designing or developing secure embedded systems across hardware, firmware, and software layers.

- Experience with embedded processors or devices such as Xilinx, NXP, Microchip, or similar platforms.

- Experience with embedded software development in environments such as Linux and/or RTOS.

- Experience in networking protocol development and network security, including detailed design and/or implementation of protocols and security capabilities in embedded software or firmware.

- Experience with security architecture and design for embedded or networked systems, including secure boot, roots of trust, trusted execution, cryptographic integration, or similar platform security capabilities.

- Strong programming experience in C/C++ and at least one additional language such as Rust or Ada.

- Experience applying recognized cryptographic standards and guidance, including familiarity with NIST algorithms and standards.

- Location: Grand Rapids, MI. This is a fully onsite position requiring attendance five days per week. A comprehensive corporate relocation package is available for eligible candidates.

Desired Characteristics

- Experience with configuration, testing, and certification of High Assurance and/or Cross Domain Solution products.

- Experience designing and implementing networking protocols including IPv4, IPv6, ARP, ICMP, IGMP, DHCP, TCP, UDP, and NTP.

- Experience implementing and integrating IPsec and IKEv1 and/or IKEv2.

- Experience with hardware-based security technologies such as UEFI, TPM, ARM TrustZone, Secure Boot, or similar root-of-trust technologies.

- Experience with Linux operating system security and platform hardening.

- Experience with cryptographic libraries such as OpenSSL and/or wolfSSL.

- Experience with embedded development in an RTOS environment, such as VxWorks or FreeRTOS.

- Experience with cross-domain solutions, trusted data transfer, or high-assurance architectures.

- Experience with anti-tamper technologies, side-channel analysis, redundancy patterns, and other vulnerability avoidance/mitigation techniques.

- Experience with penetration testing, attack vector analysis, threat modeling, or security validation of embedded and networked products.

- Demonstrated ability to take an idea from concept through productization and deployment.

- Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.

- Experience with Agile program execution and development methodologies.

Job Description Summary
You will work within multiple engineering disciplines for the design and manufacture of aircraft propellers. Whilst you work in collaboration with team members, we will develop and support you from day one.

Job Description

About GE Aerospace

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

Dowty, a GE Aerospace company is based in Gloucestershire. It is a world-leading supplier of electronically controlled, composite propeller systems for a wide range of civil and military applications, including commercial airliners and military airlifters to multi-role seaplanes and marine hovercraft.

Key programs include the Lockheed Martin C-130J, the De Havilland Dash 8-400 and the Leonardo C-27J.

Dowty’s’ in-house production expertise for composite blades includes application of resin transfer moulding processes, which have been continuously evolved and perfected since 1976, and the use of braiding machines that rapidly and accurately apply the blades’ fibre outer layers.

Role Summary

Typically, a four-year programme, the Aerospace Engineering Degree Apprenticeship is an alternative to full-time University, allowing you to study for an Aerospace Engineering Degree part time at the University of The West of England (Bristol) while gaining industrial experience working directly at Dowty Propellers on a variety of aviation projects.

The BEng Hons degree structured programme aimed at gaining a variety of competencies required for a successful career in engineering.  Supplemented by a variety of other development opportunities within the broader GE family, we believe this programme provides an excellent gateway into the wider world of advanced aerospace engineering.

Overview of the scheme

This is a broad-based programme offering a wide range of activities to build well rounded engineers with well-developed interpersonal and team-working skills. Delivered onsite at UWE 2 to 3 days per week and once per week in years 2-4, the programme consists of:

- Enrolment in the BEng Hons Aerospace Engineering degree at the University of The West of England (Bristol)

- A series of work placements within our engineering teams to gain skills and experience working on front line projects. These typically cover mechanical design, composites design, mechanical analysis, stress analysis, aero-acoustics, controls, electronics and systems engineering and manufacturing engineering

- Support from technical and pastoral mentors from both Dowty and the university

- Numerous opportunities to participate in enrichment activities, local school’s engagement, the GE apprentice network and various external events such as the Cheltenham Science Festival, Imagineering, Go4SET, GirlsGetSET and the K'Nex Challenge

Qualifications/Requirements

Please ensure you have achieved or are predicted these grades or above as these are the minimum requirements to join this apprenticeship. Failure to meet these grades could mean you are not eligible to join the programme.

Essential

- Minimum of 112 UCAS points via:​

- 3 A-Levels at grade BBC or above (including Mathematics and another STEM-based subject e.g., Physics/Electronics/Computing or similar)​

- BTEC Extended Diploma in Engineering at grade DMM or above​

- Equivalent qualification with appropriate Mathematics content

- Grade C/4 or above in English and Mathematics, or equivalent (we accept Functional Skills Level 2 in English and Maths)

Desired

- An understanding of our business and products, with an enthusiasm for the broader aerospace industry

- A commitment to personal development and community volunteering

Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process, you will be required to submit an initial CV application. After this, the stages include a video interview and assessment centre. Our recruitment team will be in touch with you at every stage to keep you updated and understand what is next in the process.

If you require any adjustments to the process to enable you to be at your best, please email the team Apprenticeship.Queries@geaerospace.com.

Please only submit one application. If you submit multiple applications, we will progress the most suitable one. If in future you are deemed to be suitable for other opportunities, we will automatically consider you for these too.

Please note our applications will close on 1st November but may close earlier dependent on application volumes. We would encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Total Reward

At GE Aerospace we understand the importance of Total Reward. Our flexible benefits plan, called FlexChoice, gives you freedom, choice, and flexibility in the way you receive your benefits, as well as giving you the opportunity to make savings where possible.

As a new joiner to GE, we are pleased to be able to offer you the following as default in your benefit fund, which you then can tailor to meet your individual needs.

- Non-contributory Pension

- Life Assurance

- Group income protection

- Private medical cover

- Holiday Hourly equivalent of 26 days, with flexible option to buy or sell

Security Clearance

Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance is required and must be maintained for this role. Please note that in the event that BPSS clearance cannot be obtained, you may not be eligible for the role and/or any offer of employment may be withdrawn on grounds of national security. Please see the link below for further details regarding the requirements for BPSS clearance: BPSS

Right to Work

Applications from job seekers who require sponsorship to work in the UK are welcome and will be considered alongside all other applications. However, under the applicable UK immigration rules as may be in place from time to time, it may be that candidates who do not currently have the right to work in the UK may not be appointed to a post if a suitably qualified, experienced and skilled candidate who does not require sponsorship is available to take up the post. Further, sponsorship is not available for our Early Careers opportunities. For further information please visit the UK Visas and Immigration website.

Whether we are manufacturing components for our engines, driving innovation in fuel and noise reduction, or unlocking new opportunities to grow and deliver more productivity, our GE Aerospace teams are dedicated and making a global impact. Join us and help move the aerospace industry forward.
