Job Description Summary

Job Description

NDT Tech II - FPI

About GE Aerospace:

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

Working at our Beavercreek Site:

GE Aerospace operations have been part of the Beavercreek community for over 75 years! Our Beavercreek facility on Research Blvd. manufactures gas turbine tubes, ducts, and manifolds, and also has complex machining, fabrication and investment casting capabilities. Product engineering, new product development and testing is performed on site. This facility also does repair and overhaul of tubes, ducts, and manifolds. Our location on Heller drive manufactures turbine airfoils and has a focus on next generation technology. We have been awarded OSHAS’s highest safety rating.

Role Overview:

This is a challenging role that involves performing all required inspections, tests, and evaluations in Liquid penetrant. You will also ensure all equipment, personnel, and planning are maintained for proficient operation and quality compliance.

- The FPI Technician will be performing calibrations, Nondestructive Tests, and evaluations for acceptance or rejection determinations according to written instructions and record results.
- FPI Technicians are qualified to set up and calibrate equipment and to interpret and evaluate results with respect to applicable codes, standards, and specifications.
- FPI Technicians are thoroughly familiar with the scope and limitations of the method of NDT being used and should exercise assigned responsibility for on-the-job training and guidance of assistants and level I technicians.
- Ensuring strict adherence to safety regulations.
- Conduct tests to ensure quality or detect discontinuities (defects) using NDT methods of inspection.
- Apply testing criteria in accordance with applicable specifications or standards and evaluate results.
- Organize and report test results.
- Assist in the development and implementation of advanced technical inspections.
- Perform other job-related tasks as assigned by management.

The Ideal Candidate:

In this role the ideal candidate will primarily perform fluorescent penetrant inspections of weldments and tubing, castings, etc. in accordance with company/customer drawings and specifications.

Required Qualifications:

- High school diploma or GED.
- Must possess a current or past certification in accordance with NAS410 as a certified Level 2 Liquid Penetrant inspector.
- Must provide documented PTL2 qualification and training records.
- 6 months demonstrated experience in the use of basic hand tools for setting up equipment, fixtures, and parts for inspection.
- Pass the eye test requirements per NAS410. (Near vision 20/25 and color perception)
- This role may encounter high risk or hazardous operations and/or include working shifts beyond a standard work week. As such, a requirement of the role is to be at least 18 years of age by the time of joining.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Multiple Certifications held in NDT.
- Technical degree or Vocational degree in NDT.
- Proficient in the use of shop math (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division and use of fractions and decimals) with the ability to learn and apply trigonometry and geometry.
- Understands repair process and service induced discontinuities related to aviation hardware overhauled and repaired.
- Experience in basic computing
- Experience performing basic CNC and/or Robotic programming used for inspections.
- Experienced in the use of basic shop mechanical measurement equipment such as mic's, verniers, dial indicators, or length scales.
- Knowledge of material and chemical handling practices.
- Ability to perform basic machine preventative maintenance and calibration of equipment to known standards.
- Experience operating material handling and lifting devices, including ability to obtain forklift license if required

Additional Information:

- Wages $29.85 + per hour based on experience
- Additional 10%/hour premium for 2nd or 3rd shift
- Must be able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds on occasion. Items more than 50 pounds will be lifted with assistance.

Closing:

We strive to keep a fun and enjoyable shop atmosphere while maintaining the highest level of quality work output. We work together to make the impossible happen and we are looking for people like YOU to join us! We’re looking for team-oriented individuals with the ability to share ideas and make recommendations with peers and leadership.

postings.title: Opérateur.trice de production - Fin de Semaine - Jour
postings.location: Saint-Eustache, Quebec, Canada
postings.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

Formation sur place

Progression salariale rapide:
Salaire à l’entrée: 25,97$/h
Après 520 heures (≈ 3 mois) votre salaire sera de 26,62$/h
Après 1040 heures (≈ 6 mois) votre salaire sera de 27,27$/h
Après 2080 heures (≈ 1 an) votre salaire sera de 27,92$/h
Révision salariale annuelle par la suite.

Nos opérateurs de production de Fin de Semaine (jour) travaillent vendredi, samedi et dimanche (3X12 heures) horaire de 7h00 à 19h00.

Voici ce que nous vous offrons de plus….

Prime de 750$ à l’embauche*

- Boni annuel pouvant aller jusqu'à 2.5% de votre salaire
- Remboursement pour pratique d’un sport ou conditionnement physique (300$/année)
- Rabais employés (forfait téléphonique, assurances, appareils électroménagers, etc.)
- Assurances maladie, dentaire et vision au premier jour d'embauche
- Fonds de pension avec cotisation de l'employeur
- Régime d’achats d’actions
- Vacances disponibles dès l’embauche
- Programmes d’aide aux employés et à la famille (PAEF)
- Uniforme, chaussures et lunettes de sécurité fournis
- Environnement tempéré
- Pauses payées
- Accès télémédecine
- Possibilité d'avancement professionnel dans une compagnie en pleine croissance

​

*payable après 520 heures travaillées, vous devez toujours être à l’emploi et actif au moment du paiement.

Responsabilités:

- Opérer les tamiseurs automatiques (identification des pots, analyse des résultats, changement et nettoyage des tamis);
- Opérer le mélangeur;
- Opérer le séparateur à gaz;
- Opérer le traitement antistatique;
- Faire l’emballage (mise en pots, étiquetage, mise en boîtes);
- Compléter les documents de production, à chaque station de travail;
- Préparer et opérer des unités de productions de poudres métalliques;
- Participer aux diagnostiques des problèmes reliés à la mauvaise qualité de la poudre métallique;
- Respecter le système d’assurance qualité;
- Nettoyer le poste de travail (après tous les quarts de travail)
- Jeter les poubelles (1 fois par semaine)

Qualifications et exigences :

Requis Physique: Pouvoir manipuler des poids d’environ 45lbs (max 22kg)

Compétences souhaitées :

- Capacité à accomplir des tâches demandant un effort physique
- Être capable de travailler assis et/ou debout
- Langue: français
- Aptitudes mathématiques de bas

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

postings.title: PCB Electronic Assembler 2
postings.location: Bohemia, New York, United States of America
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
As an Electronic Assembly Technician at GE Aerospace, you will independently perform assembly tasks including PC board assembly, soldering, and mechanical assembly, ensuring each step meets quality specifications. You will use various tools and testing equipment, maintain accurate records, and provide training and mentoring to colleagues. This role requires a high school diploma or GED, relevant certifications, and 1-3 years of manufacturing experience, with a focus on precision, safety, and effective communication.

Job Description

At GE Aerospace in Bohemia, you will be part of a collaborative and diverse team that values your unique perspectives and innovative spirit. You will have the opportunity to work smarter, not harder, through our ongoing LEAN transformation. Your contributions will have a meaningful impact on millions of lives, and you will share in our sense of purpose and pride. If you are ready to elevate your future, come aboard and help us advance aviation technologies for today and tomorrow..

- Career Growth: GE isn’t just a great place to start your career—it’s a great place to expand and grow your career. Many entry-level employees grow into leadership roles in operations or other parts of the business. There are also opportunities to continue your career at GE in Bohemia or across the globe.

- Benefits: Our range of benefits includes health care starting on day one, 401 (k) savings plan with generous employer match, paid time off and more

- Education Assistance: GE encourages employees to continue their education and provides financial support to further employee learning.

- Work environment: GE Aerospace facility located in Islip, Long Island is dedicated to the design and manufacture of power conversion & control products, Battery systems, Lighting Controllers, Frequency Converters, Digital Control Products, Control Panels, Inverters, Power supplies and Advanced power conversion applications.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

- Independently perform assembly steps including PC board assembly and soldering, chassis wiring and soldering, mechanical assembly, and inspection.

- Follow operation sheets, engineering drawings, and change orders to accurately complete assembly tasks.

- Ensure each step in the process is completed correctly, meeting quality specifications.

- Maintain records to charge direct labor time to specific product amounts.

- Use a variety of small hand tools and production equipment and set up and operate testing equipment such as multimeters, ohmmeters, and flow meters.

- Provide training and mentoring to other employees as needed.

- Perform other routine operations as required.

- Communicate effectively in written and/or oral form regarding various situations.

- Keep your workstation, tools, and equipment organized and orderly.

- Comply with all company safety rules and regulations.

- Engage and participate in a self-directed teaming environment.

Requirements/Knowledge:

Education:

- High School Diploma or GED

- IPC-A-610 Certification

- J-STD-001 Certification

Experience:

- 1-3 years of manufacturing experience

Skill Level Required:

- Proficiency with basic tools and measuring devices such as micrometers, calipers, and radius gauges.

- Basic computer skills.

- Simple mathematical counting skills.

- Ability to interpret drawings, operation sheets, and perform in-process inspections.

- Good hand-eye coordination and dexterity skills.

- This role may encounter high risk or hazardous operations and/or include working shifts beyond a standard workweek. As such, a requirement of the role is to be at least 18 years of age by the time of joining.

Desired Qualifications:

- Previous experience in a manufacturing environment.

- Experience in a self-directed teaming environment.

- Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles.

The base pay range for this position is $20 - $25/hr. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on 9/1/2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness. ​

GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). Each Sponsor reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Additional Information

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Aerospace will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

postings.title: PCB Soldering & Assembly Technician (Electronics Assembler III) Control Panels
postings.location: Bohemia, New York, United States of America
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
Join our team as an Electronics Assembler, where you'll perform precision disassembly, reassembly, and testing of cutting-edge electronic products using advanced tools and equipment. You'll mentor teammates, troubleshoot using schematics, and ensure every product meets the highest quality standards while adhering to safety regulations. With 3-5 years of electronics assembly experience and certifications like IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, and IPC-7711, you'll play a vital role in driving innovation and excellence in manufacturing.

Job Description

About the Role

Join our team as an Electronics Assembler III where precision, soldering skill, and hands‑on electronics craftsmanship are essential. You will disassemble, reassemble, test, and troubleshoot complex power conversion and control products, ensuring they meet strict quality and safety standards. This role is central to delivering products that power aviation technologies.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform precision soldering and rework on printed circuit boards (PCBs) and electronic sub‑assemblies to IPC standards.

- Disassemble and reassemble chassis, sub‑assemblies, and components with minimal instruction while maintaining high quality.

- Set up and operate test equipment: digital/analog voltmeters, oscilloscopes, Hi‑Pot testers, and other diagnostic tools; interpret schematics to isolate and repair faults.

- Mentor and cross‑train teammates in assembly, soldering best practices, and troubleshooting techniques.

- Interpret engineering drawings and specifications; recommend process and quality improvements.

- Maintain organized workstations, calibration of tools, and strict adherence to safety procedures and SQDC (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost).

Required Qualifications

- Hands‑on soldering experience (see specifics below).

- Certifications: IPC‑A‑610, J‑STD‑001, and IPC‑7711 (or ability to obtain).

- Experience: 3–5 years of electronics assembly and testing in a manufacturing environment.

- Proficiency using hand tools, gauges, schematics, and electronic test equipment.

- Strong dexterity, excellent hand‑eye coordination, and basic computer skills.

- High School Diploma or GED.

- This role may encounter high risk or hazardous operations and/or include working shifts beyond a standard workweek. As such, a requirement of the role is to be at least 18 years of age by the time of joining.

Preferred Soldering Skills and Experience

- Demonstrated ability in both through‑hole and surface‑mount soldering (SMT and THT), including component replacement and rework.

- Experience with soldering under microscope, using hot air rework stations, irons of varied wattages, and solder paste/flux handling.

- Familiarity with solder quality inspection per IPC‑A‑610 criteria and performing corrective rework per IPC‑7711.

- Ability to solder fine‑pitch ICs, connectors, and power components reliably and repeatably.

Why Join Us

- Career Growth: GE isn’t just a great place to start your career—it’s a great place to expand and grow your career.  Many entry-level employees grow into leadership roles in operations or other parts of the business.  There are also opportunities to continue your career at GE in Bohemia or across the globe.

- Benefits: Our range of benefits includes health care starting on day one, 401 (k) savings plan with generous employer match, paid time off and more

- Education Assistance: GE encourages employees to continue their education and provides financial support to further employee learning.

- Work environment: GE Aerospace facility located in Islip, Long Island is dedicated to the design and manufacture of power conversion & control products, Battery systems, Lighting Controllers, Frequency Converters, Digital Control Products, Control Panels, Inverters, Power supplies and Advanced power conversion applications.

Are you passionate about precision, quality, and innovation? Join our team as an Electronics Assembler, where you'll play a pivotal role in crafting cutting-edge electronic products that power the future. We’re seeking a detail-oriented professional with a strong background in electronics assembly and testing, who thrives in a collaborative environment and is driven to deliver excellence.

Job Description Summary
The Pittsburgh On Wing Support Test Operation Site Leader is responsible for the end-to-end leadership of the Pittsburgh Test Cell operation, ensuring safe, high-quality, and efficient delivery of engine test in support of our customers.

This role owns Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) performance for the site, will lead a multi-shift team, and drives continuous improvement to meet customer commitments. The Pittsburgh site is nearing final phases of construction and remodeling – this leader will have the opportunity to transition the site into operation and build a best in class team and organization.

The Pittsburgh On Wing Support Site Leader will be expected to lead the site consistent with our FLIGHT DECK operating system to meet immediate business objectives and engage in structured problem solving.

On Wing Support is a 24 / 7 / 365 operation across multiple global time zones. This role is expected to be willing and flexible, within reason, to accommodate and support the global network.

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities:

- Maintain, grow, and actively promote a safe, open-reporting culture within the team, ensuring the engine test cell is established and operated with an uncompromising focus on Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost in that order. Demonstrate through actions and decisions the highest standards of integrity, operational discipline, and hazard awareness in a high-energy test environment.

- Respect for People – Lead transparently, foster an inclusive and engaged team environment, and build a test organization with the technical depth, operational mindset, and diverse perspectives needed to safely commission and operate the engine test cell. Develop team capability through coaching, training, and clear accountability.

- Customer Focus – Understand what matters most to internal and external customers in an on-wing support test operation, including responsiveness, technical accuracy, turnaround time, and confidence in test results. Prioritize the team’s work to maximize customer impact, measure performance through the customer lens, and use feedback to strengthen test execution and service delivery.

- Continuous Improvement – Establish a candid, humble, and transparent approach to problem solving and learning within the test operation, using lessons learned from commissioning, early operations, and daily execution to improve standards, eliminate waste, and drive reliability, repeatability, and flow through proactive kaizen.

- Fulfil the obligations of the Accountable Manager to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and any other applicable regulatory authorities, ensuring the test cell achieves and maintains the certifications, approvals, operating readiness, and procedural control required to support projected customer, product, and capability demand. Provide leadership and oversight within GE Aerospace’s Quality and Safety Management Systems throughout start-up and ongoing operations.

- Ensure the test site remains compliant with all applicable domestic and international laws, environmental requirements, permit conditions, industry regulations, financial controls, and tax obligations, including those associated with operating and maintaining an engine test facility.

- Ensure that all fundamentals of FLIGHT DECK are implemented across the full scope of the test cell operation, including start-up, daily management, standard work, action planning, problem solving, and operating cadences, and use FLIGHT DECK to run the operation and continuously improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.

- Develop and deliver the site’s long-term strategy for the engine test operation while identifying future capability expansions, new product introduction needs, and test technology enhancements required to support evolving demand.

- Ensure the site has the necessary resources to deliver the strategic growth plan and sustain test operations, including workforce planning, hiring, training and certification, retention, organizational design, tooling, infrastructure, digital systems, and capital investment needed to safely commission, operate, and scale the test cell.

- Ensure the site is a responsible and proactive member of the local community, operating the test facility with appropriate environmental stewardship, professionalism, and engagement, while contributing positively within the surrounding area.

- Build and maintain productive relationships with relevant stakeholders – including customers, other OWS sites, the Global OWS team, ATMRO sites, GE Aerospace Product, Customer, Engineering, Quality, and Technical teams, regulatory authorities, and local industry partners – to ensure strong alignment on test readiness, operational performance, and future capability needs.

This is achieved through workscoping; router management; process standardization; SB applicability and configuration decision-making by engine serial number; tooling, facility, and workstation
setup; and escalations (Departure Records and DICAs) to PSE.
Positive working relationships with the team of technicians and customers through outstanding customer responsiveness is critical to the success of the business.
Applicants will be familiar with quick-turn aircraft engine maintenance, repair and field services,
CCAR-66 TA personal license holder is a MUST-HAVE

Job Description

Company Overview

GE Aerospace (NYSE: GE) is a global leader in aerospace propulsion, services, and integrated systems. Currently, it has approximately 44,000 in-service commercial aircraft engines worldwide. With a century-long history of innovation and profound industry expertise, GE Aerospace is committed to inventing the future of flight, lifting people up, and bringing them home safely.

Site Overview

For 45 years in China, GE Aerospace has committed to developing and investing in China’s aviation industry with reliable, efficient, sustainable, and outstanding products and services. GE Aerospace and its joint venture CFM have served more than 60 airline customers in the Greater China Region, with over 7700 engines in service and nearly 5000 engines on order. We are devoted to the market’s quality growth propelled by technological innovation and digitalization. Together with our partners, we are shaping a sustainable future of flight that helps the industry reach its carbon-neutral goal for the benefit of us all tomorrow.

Role Overview

The OWS Shanghai Engineering leader will be responsible for leading a high-performance engineering team and the engineering benchmark associated with the manufacturing (disassembly, repair, and assembly) process and the industrialization and eventual standardization of the shop’s repair processes including workscope and workstation preparedness.

The Ideal Candidate

GE On Wing Support is a 24 / 7 / 365 operation. Applicants must be willing and able to support calls during off-hours when emergency situations arise.

In addition, the On Wing Support Shanghai Engineering leader will:

• Provide technical leadership to shop operations, Quality Control, etc. regarding: workscope and evaluation for engines and/or components; service bulletins; modifications; configuration; new repair techniques for engines assigned. Establish tollgates to ensure compliance.

• Be responsible for shop’s integration and execution of Service Bulletins, Airworthiness Directives, Special Procedures, and regular and unscheduled maintenance tasks to ensure Regulatory, Customer, and OEM requirements have been satisfied.

• Receive engine-specific workscopes, special work orders, repair order, etc. from CTP, product engineering and / or customers, evaluate, and translate into enterprise tool. Convert incoming records for workscope applicability and configuration management.

• Develop, in detail, methods procedures that include tooling, adapters, special

equipment requirements and their application, processing techniques to repair, and ultimately the step sequence methodology in which tasks should be completed in accordance with approved data. Identify special check procedures plus additional information as required. Work on a global team to create, regularly review, and improve these global routers. Translate output into enterprise system.

• Partner with production and planning teams to coordinate workscopes, etc. to

effectively complete engine repairs in the shop or at offsite locations through-out the world.

• Initiate DRs/DICAs and follow through disposition. Engage Product Support Engineering and/or other resources to eliminate fleet issues.

• Provides necessary equipment and tooling engineering support as required. Anticipate and respond to identified needs, both immediate and projected. Work to assure efficient operations by providing necessary services and planning. Maintain / organize facility and tooling as required. Introduce new tooling and advanced technology to improve the repair process. Instruct technician group in tooling usage as required.

• Liaison across multiple departments include both the internal team and customers to ensure seamless service and work scope execution.

• Assure proper documentation of technical data generated for the assigned projects and tasks. Ensure consistency with engineering policies and procedures, and customer requirements

• Monitor and communicate project status, business issues and significant developments

• Participate in problem-solving process. Perform as a problem-solver, as necessary, to ensure adherence to quality and schedules.

• Support Quality activities related to defect investigations and corrective action

implementation from a technical perspective.

• Understand appropriate Aircraft Maintenance Manual, Engine Shop Manual procedures.

• Demonstrate required knowledge of OWS Quality Procedures, as well as FAA/EASA Part 145 requirements and procedures. Act in accordance with the site’s Repair Station and Quality Control Manual and other applicable regulation/bounds.

• Deliver “all-hands on deck” support for AOGs (Aircraft On Ground) as they arise.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college

• Minimum of 10 years of experience with engine maintenance, trouble shooting, and assembly and min 3 years as engineering leader role

• CCAR-66 Civil Aircraft Maintenance Personnel License is MUST-HAVE and CCAR-66 English Leve 4 is MUST-HAVE

• Availability to work flexible shift patterns as required

• Ability and willingness to support calls during off-hours when emergency situations arise

Preferred Qualifications

• Demonstrated Approaches work with a “can-do” attitude and a sense of commitment to both the team and customer objectives

• Possess a desire to learn and grow with technology advancements and new engine models.

• Features strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including problem-solving ability.

• Holds previous LEAP, GE90, CFM, CF6, CF34, and GENX experience and international field experience. This knowledge to include Line maintenance, engine changes, module removal & installation, and/or LRU removals and installations.

• Proven leadership experience leading initiatives of moderate scope and impact.

• Demonstrated quality, compliance, and customer satisfaction skills

• Strong oral and written communication skills.

At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. Where others stop, we accelerate.

Job Description Summary

Job Description

About GE Aerospace

If you want to do work that really matters among a team of spirited and collaborative individuals, you need to know more about GE Aerospace. We’ve become a world leader in the design, development and manufacture of advanced aviation technologies including jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We’re a people-first organization that will bring out your best ideas and performance as part of our on-going LEAN transformation. We believe that the world works better when it flies. Do you? If so, come aboard.

Working at our Lynn Facility

Come and elevate your career in a facility that combines a rich tradition of aviation technology with a deep commitment to the future of flight. The GE Aerospace manufacturing site in Lynn designs, produces, assembles, and tests military and commercial aircraft engines and components. With more 2,500 employees and 1.6 million sqft of manufacturing space, we’re making a huge contribution to the future of flight. And, considering that very first jet engines were born here in 1942, we clearly are the career home of people who are deeply knowledgeable about building quality engines. What’s more, GE Aerospace has invested more than $100 million in our facility in the last five years alone.

By engaging with highly collaborative teams, we’re reaching for new Sustainable Aviation Fuel milestones every year. And by encouraging our teams to join us in extensive community service and volunteerism, we’re making a difference in all the ways that matter.

Here are just a few of the best reasons you will want to consider us:

- Do work with a real purpose helping to solve the global challenge of how the world flies more sustainably.
- Be a part of a global workforce of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, ideas, and experiences where everyone feels supported and respected.
- Earn merit-based rewards and incentives.
- Free Onsite Parking.
- Set work schedule with no mandatory overtime.
- Work in a climate-controlled building out of the elements.
- Have opportunities for continuous learning and development.

Essential Responsibilities:

- Operate all boilers and boiler auxiliaries in the power plant, including all types of equipment to support the entire facility
- Support the organization and determination of boiler load and load distribution
- Report operating conditions to and operate under the direction of Power Plant Engineer
- Operating includes communication between operators and maintaining proper operating conditions, boiler pressure, steam temperature, water levels and operating all types of auxiliary power plant equipment
- Take required action in emergencies, report any unsafe conditions, keep area clean, etc.
- Monitor alarm panel and take actions to alarms and or notify appropriate personnel
- Make tests on water and determine characteristics such as sulfate, alkalinity, phosphate, solids and oxygen on water condition
- Prepare records, record data and make necessary correction to control water condition
- Perform related duties to maintain proper water treatment
- Report unusual or unsafe conditions and take action when needed and or notify appropriate personnel, take required action in emergencies
- Comply with all state regulations regarding boiler / turbine operation and all state records and logs must be completed
- Complete and maintain company records and logs relative to all phases of the power plant operation and maintenance requests
- Must be knowledgeable of all power plant systems including steam and water lines, condensate lines, surge tank lines, compressed air lines and all other lines pertinent to the operation of the facility
- Power Plant Operators must wear proper PPE for work being performed, keep assigned areas clean and provide communication to Power Plant Operators and Power Plant Engineers
- Perform other duties as required
- Rotating Shift
- 4/10 hour days with Additional Weekly Overtime Available!
- Sign on Bonus Opportunity!

Qualifications/Requirements:

- High School Diploma or equivalent education (GED)

- Commonwealth of Massachusetts 2nd Class Firemen's license.

Eligibility Requirements:

- Power Plant Operators must wear proper PPE for work being performed
- Ability and Willingness to work rotating shifts
- Willing to work in area with elevated heat and noise
- Ability to lift, move and manipulate fixtures and component hardware up to 40 lbs. (with or without reasonable accommodations)
- Ability to work in confined areas, work off ladders, platforms and heights

Desired Characteristics:

- Experience as an operating engineer
- Experience in the operation of oil and gas fired high pressure boilers, water softeners, air compressors and related auxiliary equipment
- Experience with computers, applications, and keyboarding
- Have knowledge and understand safety rules in an industrial setting
- Ability to troubleshoot problems

The pay for this position is 23.50/hr. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on 12/31/2026.

Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness. ​

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Job Description Summary
The AI Engineer is the senior individual contributor who owns the end-to-end build and productionization of AI enabled engineering capabilities across the business organizations of an aero engine and propulsion OEM. The role takes the reference architecture and patterns set by the AI Architect and turns them into robust, secure, scalable production services with great UX, multimodal, agentic LLM and other AI solutions, hardened against real engine engineering data and workflows across design, simulation, test, manufacturing, and sustainment. It embeds with the engineering teams of its assigned business, owns the build and release lifecycle for the capabilities it delivers, and stays hands on, architecting and building services and making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs rather than reviewing from a distance. Deep credibility in the
physics and engineering of the product, turbomachinery, aerodynamics, combustion, heat transfer, structures, and materials, and product mindset shaped by certified, safety critical hardware are core to the role.

Job Description

In this role, you will:

- Develop and own product build and release procedures and the end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, for a single release or multiple releases, working across the immediate team and other teams across the businesses.

- Productionize multimodal, agentic LLM and other AI solutions, applied to engine and propulsion engineering problems across design, analysis, test, manufacturing, and sustainment, as robust, secure, scalable systems with great UX; architect and build end to end services.

- Ground every capability in the realities of aero engine, propulsion, and turbomachinery engineering, integrating AI with CFD, FEA, thermal and structural analysis, engine and test data, model-based systems engineering, the digital thread, and PLM, so it augments how engines are designed, analyzed, tested, certified, and sustained.

- Lead others to find creative solutions within complex, interdependent engineering and production processes with technical variety, turbomachinery design, analysis, and test cycles, employing sophisticated operational / product management, manufacturing, and engineering techniques, drawing on multiple internal and external resources and questioning conflicting data to arrive at decisions.

- Take the reference architecture, patterns, and governance set by the AI Architect and deliver against them, keeping solutions compliant with data, security, and export control requirements (ITAR / export control, CMMC, RMF / ATO) across classified and unclassified environments.

- Own the model and agent delivery lifecycle in production: data pipelines, CI/CD, containerized deployment, model and agent serving, monitoring, and the build and release pipeline.

- Interpret internal and external business challenges and recommend best practices to improve products, processes, and services; use industry trends to inform the decision making process.

- Lead the delivery of projects with moderate to significant technical complexity and risk; present business and technical discipline solutions to senior leaders.

- Inform technical investment decisions, compute, model hosting, tooling, and build vs. buy, and the resourcing needed to deliver, working within program and project budgets.

- Communicate complex messages and negotiate internally and with external partners, vendors, and customers to adopt a point of view and influence peers to act.

- Act as an expert resource and best practice authority for the engineers embedded across the businesses, providing technical leadership, design review, and mentorship without direct management authority.

- Develop peer, cross functional, and cross business relationships to maximize best practice sharing and team effectiveness.

- Transition delivered capabilities to program ownership with documentation and trained users rather than leaving orphaned pilots.

- Share technical, procedural, and business knowledge with others, and support a continuous learning culture through learning content, presentations, and mentoring.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a STEM major

- Minimum of 10 years of overall engineering experience

- Production AI/ML systems and end to end service delivery experience required throughout.

- This role requires the successful candidate to maintain a US Government Security Clearance; prerequisite for a security clearance is U.S Citizenship. Preference is given to candidates who currently hold a US Government Security Clearance.

- Legal authorization to use in the U.S is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening

Desired Characteristics Technical Expertise

- Working fluency in the physics and engineering of aero engines and turbomachinery, aerodynamics, combustion, heat transfer, structures and rotordynamics, and materials, with the judgment to tell where a model is physically credible; hands on familiarity with CFD, FEA, and thermal/structural simulation, engine and rig test data, surrogate and physics informed modeling, model based systems engineering, the digital thread, and PLM.

- Strong software development in Python and at least one systems language (C++, Rust, Go, or Java), with solid API, version control, and testing practice.

- Strong DevSecOps and MLOps capability: cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and tooling such as MLflow or Kubeflow, with security applied across DevOps and MLOps.

- Applied production experience with LLM, retrieval augmented generation, and agentic frameworks, including multimodal AI, building robust, secure, scalable services with strong UX, and moving solutions from prototype to scaled production.

- Ability to architect and build end to end services and integrate them with the digital thread, PLM, and existing enterprise and simulation systems.

- Working knowledge of configuration choices and related cost implications, compute, model hosting, and build vs. buy, and experience with complex solution configurations.

- Experience delivering inside aerospace & defense or comparable regulated constraints: ITAR / export control, CMMC, RMF / ATO, and airgapped or impact level environments. Business Acumen

- Interprets internal and external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes, and services; stays informed of industry trends to inform decision making.

- Understands how the internal and external business model works, engine and propulsion programs, certification, and service / MRO, and uses that understanding to prioritize delivery.

- A product mindset for safety critical, certified hardware: comfort with verification and validation, certification evidence, reliability, and the long product and service lifecycle of an engine program.

- Able to articulate the value of what is most important to the business, applying presentation and storytelling concepts for cross functional teams.

Leadership

- Acts as an expert resource and technical thought leader for colleagues with less experience, providing design guidance and mentoring.

- Strong oral and written communication, with strong interpersonal and leadership skills and the ability to communicate and influence effectively across all organizational levels.

- Demonstrated ability to lead programs and projects, with established project management skills and the ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.

- Demonstrated ability to work with and/or lead blended teams, including third party partners and customer personnel.

- Demonstrated change management / acceleration capabilities.

- Proven analytical and problem resolution skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus across engineering, IT, and platform teams and leadership.

- Ability to negotiate internally and with external partners, vendors, and customers.

Job Description Summary
We are seeking a Private Markets Leader with insurance company experience for an approximately $45 billion insurance investment portfolio. The mandate spans the full private markets landscape — investing through primary funds, co-investments and single-asset transactions, secondaries (LP-led and GP-led continuation vehicles), including strategic seeding/anchor commitments across asset classes and risk spectrum.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Originate, structure, and execute investments across asset classes and structures, leading diligence, valuation, legal negotiation, and Investment Committee approval

- Drive portfolio construction: commitment pacing, vintage and manager diversification, and liquidity planning against a long-duration liability profile

- Structure for capital efficiency within insurance regulatory and rating agency capital frameworks, including rated feeders and bespoke SMAs

- Build strategic GP relationships, positioning the platform as a partner of choice for co-investment, seeding, and bespoke mandates

- Oversee portfolio monitoring, valuations, amendments, advisory boards, and secondary sale decisions; lead and develop investment professionals

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or CFA / CAIA preferred

- Experience with insurance capital frameworks, ALM, and capital-efficient structuring

- Significant multi-asset-class private markets experience spanning fund investing and direct/co-investment execution across Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate and Infrastructure. Must have 2 or 3 areas of expertise.

At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. As a world-leading provider of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft, we are committed to advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Joining GE Aerospace means becoming part of a collaborative and diverse team that values your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity. We listen to your ideas and support your growth through our ongoing LEAN transformation, enabling you to work smarter, not harder. Your contributions will have a meaningful impact on millions of lives, and you will share in our pride and purpose. - Ability to follow written work instructions, processes, and procedures.

postings.description:
Job Description Summary
GE Aerospace is seeking a Program Manager - DDTC Consent Agreement to lead the execution of key workstreams supporting the company’s trade compliance obligations under its Consent Agreement with the U.S. Department of State’s Directorate of Defense Trade Controls (DDTC). This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, tracking, and reporting program activities to ensure commitments, milestones, corrective actions, and reporting requirements are completed accurately and on time.

Reporting to the Executive Leader, International Trade Compliance and partnering closely with the Chief Counsel for Regulatory Affairs, the Program Manager will work across Legal & Compliance, business teams, and other functional stakeholders to drive alignment, accountability, and timely execution. The ideal candidate is a strong program leader who can manage multiple complex initiatives in a matrixed and highly regulated environment. Prior International Trade Compliance experience is not required; however, experience in compliance, legal, or other regulated settings is preferred.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Lead program management for execution of the DDTC Consent Agreement, including integrated planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and closure of actions across multiple workstreams.
- Plan and manage regular operating cadences, including weekly meetings, and partner with workstream owners to ensure commitments and milestones are delivered on time in alignment with Consent Agreement requirements and Special Compliance Officer (SCO) expectations.
- Coordinate engagement with internal leaders and external stakeholders, as needed, including the Special Compliance Officer, external auditor, and DDTC.
- Prepare executive-level status reports and briefing materials summarizing program progress, key risks, action items, resource needs, and overall performance against commitments.
- Drive cross-functional execution of Consent Agreement requirements, including support for audits, digital transformation initiatives, training, and jurisdiction/classification validation activities.
- Monitor, track, and escalate program risks, issues, and remediation actions, ensuring clear ownership, due dates, and completion criteria.
- Support the development and continuous improvement of processes, procedures, training, and governance mechanisms needed to sustain compliance commitments.
- Apply lean and process improvement principles to strengthen program execution, action tracking, reporting, and operating rhythms.
- Lead effectively in ambiguous or evolving situations, balancing long-term strategic priorities with urgent tactical actions and deadlines.

Required Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 10 years of professional experience in compliance, legal or other regulated settings OR Associates degree with minimum of 12 years of professional experience compliance, legal or other regulated settings OR High School Diploma with minimum of 14 years of professional experience compliance, legal or other regulated settings
- Minimum 8 years of professional experience in compliance, legal or other regulated settings

​

Desired Characteristics

- Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and driving multiple workstreams to completion.
- Strong experience with integrated planning, status reporting, executive communications, and stakeholder management.
- Ability to work effectively across a matrixed organization and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, including the ability to interpret, analyze, and synthesize data into actions and decisions.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including preparation of clear materials for senior leadership.
- Experience in a regulated, compliance-driven, legal, audit, or risk management environment, including support for compliance transformation, governance, remediation programs, and regulatory commitments.
- Familiarity with lean methodologies, process optimization, and structured operating cadences.
- Experience creating and managing executive-level reporting and presentations.
- Excellent communicator with strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
- Proven ability to identify, analyze, and solve ambiguous problems with strong attention to detail.
- Proactive, can-do mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

The base pay range for this position is $181,000 - $241,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on September 18th, 2026.

postings.location: Evendale, Ohio, United States of America
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!
GE Aerospace is undertaking a major, business-wide transformation as it relates to our packaging portfolio and the emerging regulatory landscape, most notably the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation and California SB 54. These requirements will impact packaging design, materials, recyclability, reporting, and extended producer responsibility across all products, sites, and channels.
We are seeking a Program Manager for Strategic Packaging with strong program and project management capability, deep packaging design and materials expertise, and continuous improvement experience. This role will lead the global packaging transformation program end-to-end, providing the technical depth needed to guide and challenge packaging solutions so they are compliant, safe, operationally efficient, and cost-effective.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the global Strategic Packaging Program. Define scope, roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and governance. Run steering forums, manage risks/issues, and ensure alignment across businesses and regions.
- Translate global regulatory requirements into a coherent packaging transformation strategy and implementation plan.
- In partnership with product/quality teams, guide the development of compliant packaging designs and global standards. Ensure new specifications (materials, structures, recyclability criteria, test protocols) protect product integrity, safety, and customer experience while meeting regulatory thresholds.
- Coordinate design, validation, and rollout of packaging changes across manufacturing, MRO, spares distribution, and logistics. Collaborate with suppliers to implement new packaging standards, support trials and qualifications, and resolve technical and operational issues.
- Drive continuous improvement in packaging: material reduction, cube and freight optimization, standardization of packaging families, increased use of reusables and recyclable content, and reduction of total landed cost.
- Lead change management for the packaging transformation. Assess impacts by product, site, and role; develop communication and training plans; coordinate training content with packaging and operations experts; and ensure new packaging standards are understood, adopted, and sustained at sites and with suppliers.
- Define and track key program KPIs, including compliance status by market/product, packaging material mix and recyclability, EPR and fee impacts, damage/quality metrics, and cost performance. Provide regular updates to senior leadership and support external reporting needs as required.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical/Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, Supply Chain, or related field; advanced degree or PMP/Prince2 a plus (or a high school diploma/GED with a minimum of 4 years packaging, product engineering, supply chain/logistics, or operations experience)
- Minimum 5 years of experience in program/project management or transformation roles.
- Demonstrated experience with packaging design and validation (materials, structural design, cushioning, testing) in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
- Familiarity with packaging-related regulatory requirements (preferably EU packaging/PPWR, EPR schemes, and/or US state-level packaging regulations).
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional, multi-site or multi-region programs, managing scope, schedule, risks, and stakeholders.
- Proficiency with project tools (e.g., MS Project/Smartsheet), data/analytics (Excel, SQL/BI a plus), and process mapping.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and vendor negotiation skills.

Desired Qualifications

- Experience in aerospace, automotive, industrial, or similarly high-value and regulated industries.
- Prior involvement in programs addressing sustainability, circularity, or extended producer responsibility.
- Familiarity with logistics operations and systems (ERP, WMS, TMS) and how packaging affects storage, handling, and transport.
- Exposure to continuous improvement/lean methods applied to packaging, logistics, or manufacturing.

Competencies

- Strategic planning and execution
- Risk management and issue resolution
- Technical credibility
- Systems integration and data readiness
- Compliance- and risk-aware
- Customer- and quality-focused
- Data-driven and improvement-oriented
- Clear, concise communication

postings.description:
Job Description Summary
As Quality System Manager you will oversee, ensure, and enhance the organization's capabilities to comply with external standards and regulations, particularly in alignment with AS 9100. This role involves collaboration with other regulatory areas, including Production Organization (POA), Maintenance Organization (MOA), and Maintenance Training Organization (MTOA). You will be responsible for defined work or projects, following individual and departmental work plans, meeting short-term objectives, and resolving issues through immediate actions or short-term planning.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

- Ensure alignment between internal policies and mandatory regulations, maintaining compliance across production and maintenance operations.

- Lead subject matter experts (SMEs) to assess and ensure compliance with AS 9100 standards and regulations such as EASA PART 21G, EASA PART 145, EASA PART 147, and foreign authorities like SACAA.

- Monitor organizational performance in terms of Quality and Safety through audits and performance KPIs.

- Define policies and procedures, ensuring their effectiveness and correct application.

- Act as a change agent to drive "Lean" operations and ensure adherence to quality procedures through audits.

- Support the quality system and promote a culture of quality across manufacturing processes.

- Establish internal processes to deliver high-quality products and services.

- Monitor process results, identify root causes of non-conformances, and implement corrective actions.

- Work with the Risk Manager to identify and assess risks effectively.

- Collaborate across the organization to promote a strong Safety Culture.

- Serve as a best practice resource, maintaining awareness of the latest developments in Quality Management.

- Communicate complex messages effectively, influencing stakeholders and building consensus.

- Use evaluative judgment to solve moderately complex tasks or problems.

- Analyze data and provide recommendations using technical expertise.

Qualifications/Requirements

- Significant experience in Quality and/or Production Regulation.

- Significant direct people management experience, experience with leading senior (SMEs) mid to large team.

- Master’s degree in Technical or Aerospace fields, or High School Diploma with previous experience in a similar role.

- Previous experience in Quality within an industrial environment

- Language proficiency: English (C1) and Czech/Slovak (C2).

- Strong organizational skills and ability to set and meet realistic deadlines.

postings.title: Quality Practitioner Apprenticeship, Dowty 2027 intake
postings.location: Gloucester, Gloucestershire, United Kingdom
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
As a Quality Practitioner Apprentice you will work within the Quality department which oversees various aspects of our Quality Management System. Quality plays a key role to ensure our products are consistent, improve our manufacturing processes and ensure customer confidence. You will cover topics such as quality management systems, internal auditing, root cause analysis and process performance. Your new skills will enable our organisation to continue the manufacture of propellers for large aircraft, including the C130J Hercules. You will study online to obtain a Quality Practitioner Level 4 with Clear Quality, and also complete some engineering topics at GET – Gloucestershire Engineering Training. Participants graduate with a Level 4 Certificate recognised by the Quality Institute (CQI).

Job Description

About GE Aerospace

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

Dowty, a GE Aerospace company is based in Gloucestershire. It is a world-leading supplier of electronically controlled, composite propeller systems for a wide range of civil and military applications, including commercial airliners and military airlifters to multi-role seaplanes and marine hovercraft.

Key programs include the Lockheed Martin C-130J, the De Havilland Dash 8-400 and the Leonardo C-27J.

Dowty’s’ in-house production expertise for composite blades includes application of resin transfer moulding processes, which have been continuously evolved and perfected since 1976, and the use of braiding machines that rapidly and accurately apply the blades’ fibre outer layers.

Role Description

As a Quality Practitioner you will support the Quality department in maintaining compliance with AS9100D, Part 145, and Part 21G requirements while developing practical skills in aviation quality assurance, audit support, and continuous improvement.

You will

· Assist with internal audits and compliance monitoring activities across QMS and SMS functions

· Support supply chain Quality in shop floor Quality Control activities

· Support Corrective Action Planning, tracking, and closure verification

· Help maintain document control records and ensure version accuracy

· Support data entry and analysis for quality metrics and trend reporting

· Assist with preparation of audit packs and evidence gathering for Regulatory oversight

· Participate in Kaizen and continuous improvement activities

You will be supported by your line manager, plus placement managers, mentors, and the wider apprentice network, to ensure you are meeting the requirements of your course and getting the most out of your apprenticeship.

Overview of the scheme

Length of Program: 2 years plus End Point Assessment, up to 6 months completion of EPA.

The first year is online work-based training with Clear Quality, where you will undertake monthly tutor-led lessons for each module. After each session, learners complete an assignment designed to apply their learning within the workplace. Concurrently you will be assigned some engineering topics to be completed at college with GET Engineering Training. You will have up to 2 years to complete all the training, plus EPA time. You will based in the workplace fulltime whilst you are training which will assist you in completing your assignments.

As you progress through the years you will become a more integrated member of the team, taking on more responsibilities in your department and within the apprenticeship community.

Qualifications/Requirements

Please ensure you have achieved or are predicted these grades or above as these are the minimum requirements to join this apprenticeship. Failure to meet these grades could mean you are not eligible to join the programme.

Essential

A successful candidate would have, or be expected to achieve by the start of the apprenticeship:

- Achieved or predicted 4 GCSEs at Grade C/4 or equivalent, including Mathematics, English.

Desired Characteristics

- Pass in a Science subject.
- Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn regulatory frameworks

- Able to roll up your sleeves and get involved in projects

- Organised & able to work towards deadlines

- Inspired and curious to learn

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Able to take ownership for projects

- Analytical and problem-solving skills

- Proficient in Microsoft Office

- Able to work as part of a team

- Interest in aerospace, aviation, or manufacturing quality systems

Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process, you will be required to submit an initial CV application. After this, the stages include a video interview and assessment centre. Our recruitment team will be in touch with you at every stage to keep you updated and understand what is next in the process.

If you require any adjustments to the process to enable you to be at your best, please email the team via Apprenticeship.Queries@geaerospace.com.

Please only submit one application. If you submit multiple applications, we will progress the most suitable one. If in future you are deemed to be suitable for other opportunities, we will automatically consider you for these too.

Please note our applications will close on Sunday 1st November but may close earlier dependant on application volumes. We would encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Total Reward

At GE Aerospace we understand the importance of Total Reward. Our flexible benefits plan, called FlexChoice, gives you freedom, choice, and flexibility in the way you receive your benefits, as well as giving you the opportunity to make savings where possible.

As a new joiner to GE, we are pleased to be able to offer you the following as default in your benefit fund, which you then can tailor to meet your individual needs.

- Non-contributory Pension

- Life Assurance

- Group income protection

- Private medical cover

- Holiday Hourly equivalent of 26 days, with flexible option to buy or sell

Security Clearance

Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance is required and must be maintained for this role. Please note that in the event that BPSS clearance cannot be obtained, you may not be eligible for the role and/or any offer of employment may be withdrawn on grounds of national security. Please see the link below for further details regarding the requirements for BPSS clearance: BPSS

Right to Work

Applications from job seekers who require sponsorship to work in the UK are welcome and will be considered alongside all other applications. However, under the applicable UK immigration rules as may be in place from time to time, it may be that candidates who do not currently have the right to work in the UK may not be appointed to a post if a suitably qualified, experienced and skilled candidate who does not require sponsorship is available to take up the post.

Further, sponsorship is not available for our Early Careers opportunities. For further information please visit the UK Visa & Immigration Website.

Whether we are manufacturing components for our engines, driving innovation in fuel and noise reduction, or unlocking new opportunities to grow and deliver more productivity, our GE Aerospace teams are dedicated and making a global impact. Join us and help move the aerospace industry forward.

postings.description:
Job Description Summary
A Raktár és Logisztikai Vezető egy belső és külső kapcsolatokkal járó szerepkör, amely a GE Aerospace Hungary wing-to-wing szállítási folyamataiért, valamint a raktározási tevékenységekért is felelős.

Job Description

FELADATOK ÉS FELELŐSSÉGI KÖRÖK

- Irányítja az órabéres csapatot, amely a szállítást és átvételt, a rendelésfelvételt, a raktározást és az anyagok gyártásba bocsátását végzi.
- Az ilyen szintű munkakör olyan személyzeti vezetőt igényel, aki képes tehetségeket felvenni és fejleszteni. Közvetlen személyzeti irányítási felelősséget foglal magában, beleértve a személyzeti és teljesítményfejlesztési feladatokat is. A szabályzat/stratégia végrehajtásához mélyreható műszaki ismereteket, analitikus gondolkodást és műszaki tapasztalatot alkalmaz.
- Ismeri a legjobb gyakorlatokat és azt, hogy a saját területe hogyan integrálódik másokkal.
- Felelős az osztály működésének tervezéséért/végrehajtásáért, műszaki szemlélettel összpontosít a szakmai tevékenységek végrehajtására
- Autonóm, de a megállapított szabályzatok alapján működik
- A munkakör lehetővé teszi a munkát érintő eljárások és gyakorlatok módosítását, amennyiben az eredmények megfelelnek az elfogadhatósági szabványoknak (minőség, mennyiség, időszerűség stb.).
- Erőforrásként szolgál a kevésbé tapasztalt kollégák számára. Információkat ad át, készségeket fejleszt, hogy a csapattagok konszenzusra jussanak a szakterületen belüli témákban. Közvetíti a teljesítményelvárásokat, és érzékeny kérdéseket is kezelhet.
- Kiépíti és fenntartja a telephely bejövő és kimenő szállítási folyamatait a GE irányelveivel összhangban. Felelős a folyamat helyi eljárásokhoz való igazításáért, valamint a pontosság/folyamathatékonyság érvényesítésére szolgáló mérőszámok meglétéért. Szükség esetén változtatásokat javasol és hajt végre.
- A telephely logisztikai költségvetésének tulajdonosa – a költséghatékonyság érdekében használja a meglévő vállalati szintű megállapodásokat, és időről időre egyszeri fuvarajánlatokat tárgyal.
- Szállítási károk esetén biztosítja, hogy minden fél megfelelő intézkedéseket tegyen a GE harmadik felekkel szembeni érdekeinek és jogainak védelme érdekében.
- Folyamatosan szem előtt tartja a szabályozó elvérásokat
- Ellenőrzi és validálja a helyi logisztikai szolgáltatásokhoz használt összes számlát
- Nyomon követi a szállítási tevékenységek logisztikai kockázatainak és lehetőségeit
- Szükség esetén kapcsolatot tart a végfelhasználóval a szállítási útvonal optimalizálásáról.

A MUNKAKÖR BETÖLTÉSÉNEK FELTÉTELEI

- Akkreditált főiskolán vagy egyetemen szerzett alapdiploma vagy középiskolai végzettség és legalább 5 éves logisztikai és raktározási folyamatokban szerzett tapasztalat
- Bizonyított tapasztalat csapatok irányításában és fejlesztésében
- Alapos ismeretek a folyamatelemzés, a projektmenedzsment és a teljesítménymenedzsment terén
- Erős adatelemzői háttér tervezési és szervezési készségekkel
- Kommunikációs képesség (szóban, írásban) angol és magyar nyelven (elvárás)

Elvárt tulajdonságok:

- Bizonyított hatékony munkavégzés képessége egy többfunkciós, globális csapatkörnyezetben
- Kiváló kommunikációs és analitikai készségek
- Képesség a szervezet minden szintjén a kapcsolatok kialakítására, fejlesztésére és kiépítésére
- Bizonyított képesség a kötelezettségvállalások végrehajtására és teljesítésére
- A légi közlekedési ágazatban szerzett tapasztalat előnyt jelent, de nem kötelező
- Az Oracle vagy SAP megrendeléskezelésben szerzett tapasztalat előnyt jelent

Job Description Summary
We are seeking a Real-Time Embedded Software Developer and Verification Engineer to join our Stores Management System (SMS) and Computing Platform Development Team in support of an undisclosed program. In this hybrid role, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle (V-model), from requirements definition and architecture through implementation, integration, verification, and validation.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience developing real-time embedded software for safety- or mission-critical applications, with strong skills in C, C++, and/or Ada, as well as experience working with bare-metal drivers, RTOS environments, and hardware/software integration. This role includes development for the AMD/Xilinx UltraScale+ MPSoC and support for software used in Stores Management Computer (SMC) and Station Carriage Control Unit applications.

Location: Grand Rapids, MI or Clearwater, FL

This position, which offers a blend of onsite and hybrid work arrangements, is based in Grand Rapids or Clearwater, FL and necessitates a presence in the office for 2-3 days each week. An extensive corporate relocation package is also available for eligible candidates.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, develop, integrate, and verify real-time embedded software across the full V-model software lifecycle

- Support all lifecycle phases including:

- requirements analysis and definition

- software architecture and detailed design

- implementation and code integration

- verification, validation, and test execution

- Contribute to the development of Stores Management Computer and Station Carriage Control Unit software within the SMS and Computing Platform team

- Develop embedded software using C, C++, and/or Ada

postings.location: Clearwater, Florida, United States of America
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
As a Receiving Inspector, you will perform incoming visual and dimensional inspections on electrical components and materials to help ensure quality, accuracy, and traceability. You will review required documentation such as COCs, COAs, and FAIs, record inspection results in company systems, and support discrepancy resolution in partnership with Quality and Receiving teams. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented candidate with manufacturing, inspection, assembly, or receiving experience who can follow procedures, use basic computer systems, and thrive in a fast-paced team environment.

Job Description

About GE Aerospace: At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies, and we lead in the development and manufacture of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. Joining us means becoming part of a collaborative and diverse team that values your unique perspectives, innovative spirit, and drive, while participating in our ongoing LEAN transformation to work smarter, not harder. Your contributions will have a meaningful impact on millions of lives, and you will share in our sense of purpose and pride.

Working at our Clearwater Location: Clearwater is a provider of engineering, circuit card assembly, OEM Avionics, and MRO services to commercial and military customers, with products and technologies that are diverse and highly sophisticated. Your work will contribute to systems that manage the performance of Boeing 737 and 787 aircraft as well as F-18s, F-35s, Harriers, and Apaches. In addition to working in a facility awarded OSHAS’s highest safety rating, you will be part of a diverse team of 400+ employees, solving the global challenge of sustainable flight, earning merit-based rewards, working in a climate-controlled environment, and having opportunities for continuous learning and development.

Are you detail-oriented and motivated by quality? As a Receiving Inspector, you will support incoming inspection activities for electrical components and materials used in production and repair operations. In this hands-on role, you will perform visual and dimensional inspections, review required quality documentation, maintain traceability records, and help ensure only conforming material enters the business.

This role is a good fit for candidates with experience in inspection, manufacturing, assembly, receiving, or other detail-focused production support environments who can follow defined procedures, use basic computer systems, and work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Core Responsibilities

- Perform incoming visual and dimensional inspections on electrical components and materials to identify damage, defects, or nonconformances.

- Verify quality documentation, including Certificates of Conformance (COC), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and First Article Inspection (FAI) packages.

- Accurately document inspection results in the Quality Management System according to established procedures.

- Maintain traceability by assigning serial numbers, scanning documents, and managing inspection records.

- Communicate inspection issues to Quality and Receiving leadership for timely resolution.

- Safely handle and move materials up to 20 pounds while following site safety and ESD requirements.

Additional Responsibilities

- Support discrepancy resolution activities, including RMA initiation and documentation, under Quality guidance.

- Use internal systems such as TIPQA, Oracle, and document management tools to support receiving and inspection activities.

- Participate in cycle counts and inventory verification activities as needed to support receiving accuracy.

- Work with Quality, Engineering, Sourcing, Fulfillment, and Receiving teams when material discrepancies arise.

- Complete required internal training, including J-STD certification within 30 days of employment.

Minimum Qualifications

- High School Diploma or equivalent.

- Ability to read and understand technical instructions, drawings, and specifications.

- Experience in manufacturing, receiving, inspection, assembly, warehouse, or other detail-oriented operational work. This broadens the candidate pool while staying aligned to the work described.

- Basic computer skills for documentation and system navigation.

- Willingness and ability to obtain J-STD certification within 30 days.

- This role may encounter high risk or hazardous operations and/or include working shifts beyond a standard workweek. As such, a requirement of the role is to be at least 18 years of age by the time of joining.

- Ability to work with hazardous materials and in non-standard shift environments as required.

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience in incoming inspection, quality, electronics assembly, or receiving.

- Familiarity with COCs, COAs, FAIs, or similar quality documentation.

- Exposure to systems such as TIPQA, Oracle, Windchill, Webdocs, Proficy, or Smartsheet.

- Experience with cycle counts, traceability records, or inventory transactions.

- Soldering experience or electronics background.

- IPC-A-610 knowledge, Class 3 preferred.

Professional Expectations

- Consistent adherence to company policies, safety standards, and break schedules.

- Professional communication with suppliers, peers, and leadership.

- Reliability, organization, attention to detail, and openness to coaching and feedback.

Join us and be part of a team that values safety, quality, and innovation. Your skills will help us deliver excellence every step of the way!

Job Description

Company Overview

GE Aerospace (NYSE: GE) is a global leader in aerospace propulsion, services, and integrated systems. Currently, it has approximately 44,000 in-service commercial aircraft engines worldwide. With a century-long history of innovation and profound industry expertise, GE Aerospace is committed to inventing the future of flight, lifting people up, and bringing them home safely.

For 45 years in China, GE Aerospace has committed to developing and investing in China’s aviation industry with reliable, efficient, sustainable, and outstanding products and services. GE Aerospace and its joint venture CFM have served more than 60 airline customers in the Greater China Region, with over 7700 engines in service and nearly 5000 engines on order. We are devoted to the market’s quality growth propelled by technological innovation and digitalization.
