Job Description Summary
The Risk Management Leader – International Trade Compliance is responsible for the development and execution of an ITC risk management framework and for providing an integrated, forward-looking view of trade compliance risk across the company. Reporting to the newly established Senior Director – Programs & Operations Leader, ITC, this role partners closely with the Central Compliance organization, and defines the methodology, governance, analytics, and reporting used to identify, assess, prioritize, monitor, escalate, and mitigate ITC risk.
This role provides leadership with visibility into where the most significant compliance risks exist, whether mitigation actions are reducing risk, and where additional action may be required.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Own and continuously improve the enterprise ITC risk management framework, methodology, and governance model; work with Compliance Enterprise Risk Management team and serve as focal for ITC risk.
- Integrate insights from the State Department Consent Agreement, ITC investigations, audits, Site Compliance Reviews, ITC monitoring activities, and other inputs into the enterprise ITC risk profile.
- Monitor corrective actions from investigations and disclosures, audits and other assessments to ensure completion and effective deployment
- In collaboration with ITC leadership, conduct assessments to check mitigation effectiveness and provide visibility into whether risk is being reduced to acceptable levels.
- Partner with ITC leadership to inform priorities, remediation actions, and control improvements.
- Establish consistent approaches for identifying, assessing, prioritizing, monitoring, escalating, and reporting ITC risk, including risks to business and operations from licensing challenges, across businesses, functions, and geographies.
- Lead enterprise ITC risk assessments and maintain an integrated view of trade compliance risk.
- Define risk criteria, thresholds, key risk indicators, and escalation mechanisms that enable consistent risk-based decision-making.
- Identify emerging and changing risks resulting from regulatory developments, business activity, customer requirements, products, and geographic footprint.
- Establish dashboards and reporting that provide leaders with actionable visibility into significant risks, trends, mitigation progress, and emerging concerns.
- Partner with the Digital Tools Leader to strengthen risk data, analytics, and reporting capabilities, including ITC risk dashboards.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 10 years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 12 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of 14 years of professional experience

- Minimum 8 years of professional experience in international trade compliance, regulatory compliance, enterprise risk management, internal controls, audit or a related discipline

- Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required.

Desired Characteristics

- Strong knowledge of international trade compliance and the regulatory environment applicable to global aerospace and defense organization.

- Demonstrated experience building or leading risk management, controls, monitoring, or compliance assessment programs.

- Ability to synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative information into actionable risk insights for senior leaders, enabling clear decisions, prioritization, and timely escalation where needed.
- Strong understanding of risk management methodologies, controls, governance, and compliance monitoring.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and executive communication capabilities, with the ability to simplify complexity, communicate with clarity, and drive informed action.

Along the way, you will learn from experienced professionals, build your network, and gain hands-on exposure to how data science supports growth in a SaaS environment.

- Analyze product and business data to identify patterns, trends, risks, and opportunities.

postings.description:
Job Description Summary
Az SAP Üzleti Tanácsadó Gyakornok junior SAP szakértőként a felel GE Aerospace veresegyházi üzemben az SAP támogatási szolgáltatás zavartalan működéséért, globálisan együttműködve a GE Aerospace SAP operatív csapataival, termékgazdákkal / termékarchitektekkel. Ez a szerepkör a felhasználói élmény javításáért felelős a szolgáltatás és a felhasználói élmény folyamatos fejlesztésével, napi szintű SAP problémák elhárításával, eszkalálásával, riportolásával egyetemben.

Job Description

Szeretnél egy olyan csapatban dolgozni, ahol valódi üzleti folyamatokat ismerhetsz meg, napi szinten segítheted a felhasználókat, és közben technológiai, problémamegoldási és együttműködési tapasztalatot szerezhetsz?
Ha érdekel az SAP világa, szívesen dolgozol emberekkel, és fontos számodra, hogy a munkádnak kézzelfogható eredménye legyen, akkor lehet, hogy pont téged keresünk.

Miben számítunk rád?

- Napi szintű támogatást nyújtasz a belső felhasználóknak SAP-val kapcsolatos kérdésekben és problémákban.
- Kezeled és nyomon követed a beérkező hibajegyeket, elvégzed az alapvető elemzést és dokumentációt.
- Együttműködsz az operációval, a felhasználókkal és szükség esetén külső partnerekkel a problémák megoldásában.
- Részt veszel rendszer- és alkalmazásváltozások, pilotok és új megoldások támogatásában.
- Segítesz az automatizálási és folyamatos fejlesztési kezdeményezésekben.
- Figyeled a visszatérő problémákat, és javaslatokat teszel az egyszerűbb, jobb felhasználói működés érdekében.
- Támogatod a tudásbázisok, útmutatók és önkiszolgáló anyagok frissítését.

Téged keresünk, ha:

- Folyamatban lévő felsőfokú tanulmányaid vannak informatikai, műszaki vagy más STEM területen.
- Magabiztosan kommunikálsz magyarul és angolul szóban és írásban is.
- Otthonosan mozogsz az MS Office használatában.
- Jól kommunikálsz, szeretsz együtt dolgozni másokkal, és nyitott vagy a tanulásra.
- Analitikusan gondolkodsz, és nem ijedsz meg attól, ha egy probléma mögé kell nézni.
- Fontos számodra a precizitás, a szabályok betartása és a minőségi munkavégzés.

Amit fontos tudnod:

- A munkavégzés javarészt helyhez kötött, ezért ebben a pozícióban rendszeres irodai jelenlétre / bejárásra van szükség.
- A pozíció célja, hogy a csapat biztosítani tudja a 14:00–22:00 közötti időszak lefedését, ezért olyan jelentkezőket keresünk, akik számára ez a munkarend vállalható.

Előnyt jelent:

- Digitális technológiai háttér
- Érdeklődés új vagy feltörekvő technológiák iránt
- SAP vagy más vállalati rendszerek használatában szerzett tapasztalat

Miért érdemes csatlakoznod?

- Valós üzleti környezetben szerezhetsz tapasztalatot
- Betekintést nyerhetsz komplex vállalati folyamatokba
- Támogató, együttműködő csapatban dolgozhatsz
- Fejlődési lehetőséget kapsz technológiai és szakmai területen is
- A munkádnak közvetlen hatása lesz a felhasználói élményre és a napi működésre

Fontos:

- Ebben a szerepben kiemelten fontos a belső szabályok, folyamatok és jogosultságok betartása. Olyan feladatot nem végezhetsz, amelyhez nem rendelkezel megfelelő jogosultsággal vagy a szükséges szakmai támogatással.
- Ha szívesen dolgoznál egy dinamikus, fejlődő környezetben, ahol egyszerre építheted a technológiai tudásodat és az üzleti szemléletedet, várjuk jelentkezésedet.

postings.location: Warsaw, Masovian, Poland
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
At GE Aerospace we believe that the world works better when it's moving. Together we are creating a future of aviation where human safety is of the greatest importance.

In our company we have been offering a flexible working model for many years now as to give our employees the possibility to adjust working hours to suit their individual needs. Our employees easily combine their professional and private responsibilities and have time to pursue their passions. No matter what stage of your career you are at, you can count on the support and mentorship of the best experts in the industry.

On GE Aerospace Warsaw campus, we design aircraft engines and develop advanced technologies such as cooling methods for engine components as well as create statistical models and software applications for aviation. We develop all solutions in diverse teams, in which the best experts eagerly share their knowledge. At GE Aerospace we work together to achieve success. What is more, a career at GE Aerospace is not only an opportunity to work in an international environment, but also a chance to gain experience while visiting laboratories, factories and repair shops around the world.

At GE Aerospace we give our employees space for comprehensive development by supporting a variety of employee initiatives and interest groups, including GE Women's Network, PRIDE Alliance, HealthAhead, Early Careers Network and GE Aerospace Volunteers. Our flexible working model is based on the concept of work-life balance, because at GE Aerospace we believe that people come first in our organization.

We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to lead the design, development, and industrialization of advanced AI solutions across the organization. This role is intended for a senior professional with deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, solution architecture, and MLOps, combined with the ability to translate business needs into scalable, secure, and high-impact AI products.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on and strategic experience across the full AI lifecycle: from opportunity shaping and architecture design to experimentation, deployment, and continuous improvement. This person will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and leadership to define and deliver AI capabilities that create measurable business value.

This role requires both technical depth and architectural leadership, including the ability to guide teams, define standards, influence direction, and ensure solutions are robust, responsible, and production-ready.

Job Description

Responsibilities

AI Architecture and Solution Design
• Define end-to-end architecture for AI and GenAI solutions, including classical ML, NLP, multimodal AI, and agentic systems.
• Design scalable and secure architectures for:
• LLM-based applications
• Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
• Agentic and multi-agent systems
• Multimodal solutions such as image-to-text, video understanding, and speech-to-text
• Translate business requirements into technical solution designs, architectural blueprints, and implementation roadmaps.
• Ensure AI solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, and compliance requirements.

Delivery Leadership
• Lead AI solution development across the full lifecycle: discovery, requirements gathering, experimentation, prototyping, testing, deployment, and production support.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to industrialize AI use cases and transition prototypes into scalable enterprise products.
• Drive best practices in AI engineering, reusable components, and platform-based delivery.
• Support project planning, estimation, prioritization, and technical risk management.

Technical Leadership
• Provide technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams including data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, analysts, and software developers.
• Mentor team members and help grow organizational capability in AI architecture, GenAI, MLOps, and responsible AI.
• Review solution designs, code, model approaches, and deployment strategies to ensure quality and maintainability.
• Contribute to technical standards, architecture governance, and design reviews.

Stakeholder Engagement
• Engage with business and functional leaders to identify AI opportunities and define high-value use cases.
• Present technical concepts and solution proposals to senior stakeholders in a clear and business-relevant way.
• Support pre-sales, RFI/RFP responses, capability presentations, and client/internal leadership discussions where applicable.
• Act as a trusted advisor on AI strategy, feasibility, scalability, and adoption.

Operational Excellence and Responsible AI
• Define and promote best practices for model deployment, monitoring, MLOps, observability, versioning, and lifecycle management.
• Ensure AI solutions are reliable, explainable where needed, and governed appropriately.
• Promote secure, sustainable, and responsible use of AI technologies across the organization.
• Stay current with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their relevance to business needs.

Required Skills and Experience

• Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

• Proven experience designing and delivering AI solutions in production environments at scale.

• Experience working across multiple phases of the AI lifecycle, from ideation to production deployment.

• Generative AI

• LLM application architecture

• Agentic workflows / multi-agent systems

• Prompt design and LLM orchestration

• Experience with cloud-based AI/ML ecosystems such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
• Experience with data pipelines, API-based integrations, and production-grade AI systems.

• Understanding of solution architecture principles, including scalability, resilience, modularity, and security.

Benefits

Join us to see your career take flight today.

- Fascinating job in dynamically growing aerospace industry

- Competitive salary, annual bonus, copyright costs tax reduction

- Diverse career opportunities globally

postings.location: Mascot, New South Wales, Australia
postings.additional_locations: Remote, Victoria, Australia
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
At GE Aerospace, our Field Service Engineers (FSEs) exemplify our core behaviors: Respect for People, Continuous Improvement, and being Customer Driven. These dedicated professionals are on the front lines, working directly with customers to solve problems and deliver the highest standards of service and support—collaborating with customers to achieve shared success.

At GE Aerospace, we shape the future of flight, lift people up, and ensure they return home safely.
In addition to their technical leadership, Senior FSEs play a pivotal role in mentoring and coaching other FSEs. They share their knowledge and experience, provide guidance on complex technical challenges, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and help define and evolve field service standards

Job Description

Company Overview:

Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!

Site Overview:

GE Aerospace in Australia, has sites in Brisbane, Newcastle, Richmond, Bundamba, and Matraville. Since 2005, we’ve driven innovation and supported avionics, propeller, and power systems across a diverse range of aircraft platforms for our customers. We are committed to developing early career talent through student-focused programs and fostering a culture of respect and community support. Be part of a team that values giving back and making a difference in the aerospace industry.

Role Overview:

Our Field Service Engineers embody this mission every day by being embedded within the customers site, delivering exceptional service and support. As an Airline Senior Field Service Engineer, you will serve as the trusted on-site technical representative for our customers, with our customers. Operating independently and remotely from GE Aerospace hubs to resolve technical challenges and drive success directly in support of our customers fleets.

As part of GE Aerospace's remote Commercial Field Service organization, you will have the opportunity to travel both roving on-site support customer needs

More specifically, you will:

- Provide Leadership and Technical Support: Lead programs and offer technical direction and assistance to the customers and other FSEs, in the operation, inspection, maintenance, and repair of assigned jet engine product lines.​
- Cross Functional Leadership: Our Senior Field Service Engineers are responsible for leading, coaching, and mentoring Field Service Engineers and collaborating effectively with other departments to drive operational excellence.
- Strategic Leadership: Guide commercial field service policy, process and strategy to drive continuous improvements across the organization. Influencing business leadership in recognizing customer needs when decision making.
- Customer Advocacy: Deliver prompt, effective solutions that address customer issues and exceed their expectations, driving loyalty and long-term partnerships.
- Monitor and Improve Reliability: Track reliability and on-wing performance, including significant events, engine removals, delays, and cancellations. Influence airline stakeholders to implement critical reliability improvements.
- Enhance Maintenance Planning: Influence long-term maintenance planning to ensure the stability of the aircraft engine fleet.​
- Interpret Technical Documentation: Support maintenance and operational activities by interpreting OEM and technical manuals.
- Evaluate Maintenance Effectiveness: Review the effectiveness of maintenance actions to identify opportunities for training and improvement.​
- Apply FLIGHT DECK(Lean Operating Model): Utilise our FLIGHT DECK principles to deliver continuous improvement in identifying proactive reliability enhancements.
- Data Analytics and Reporting: Produce data analytics and timely reports on fleet status, program updates, events, and trends for key internal stakeholders.​
- Proactive Maintenance Recommendations: As part of standard engagement provide recommendations for proactive maintenance based on engine performance analytics.​

Once sufficiently experienced, a Senior FSE may work towards achieving Controlled Title Holder (CTH) status, demonstrating exceptional technical expertise, leadership, and commitment to maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and customer satisfaction

Required Qualifications

To be considered for this opportunity, candidates must have:

- A Bachelor's of Engineering or technical degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED / technical certificate with at least 4 years of full time work experience in fields noted below)
- A minimum of 5 years of full-time working experience in either, Aerospace Field Service, airline operations or maintenance planning, engineering, aviation propulsion, or other related fields.
- Periodic travel required both interstate and overseas.
- Ability to work across multiple time zones including early morning and occasional late evening teleconferences with stakeholders locally and in the US.

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong technical expertise in aircraft engine fleet management.
- Experience in and influencing decision making in cross-functional teams.
- Significant experience using software or data analytics to make informed technical decisions and to provide recommendations to the customer or other key internal stakeholders.
- Ability to problem solve independently using sound judgement and critical thinking.
- Ability to lead, influence and deliver result orientated priorities using strong project management, analytical, time management and prioritization skills.
- Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to forge deep relations at all levels, not only with key internal stakeholders but also with the customer

Employee Benefits

- Flexible and hybrid working options
- Competitive parental leave and family support
- Health, wellbeing, and EAP resources
- Fitness reimbursement and discounted health cover
- Superannuation, salary sacrifice, and insurance benefits
- Employee discounts and cashback offers
- Learning, development, and global career opportunities
- Recognition and reward programs

At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. Where others stop, we accelerate.

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or in Business Administration

- Strong oral and written communication skills with proven persuasion abilities

The Senior Director – ITC, Strategic Licensing will be part of the ITC Leadership Team responsible for advising the ITC Executive Leader and setting the strategic vision for obtaining export authorizations for GE Aerospace. - Lead and manage the GE Aerospace export licensing and operations teams across all business divisions and subsidiaries.
- Set the strategic vision and oversee the procurement of all business critical export authorizations;
- Lead engagement and communication with government officials, as required

- Collaborate with ITC Leadership to drive continuous improvement;

postings.description:
Job Description Summary
Intergalactic now a part of Unison, a GE Aerospace Company, is a team of engineers, technologists, designers, mathematicians, and problem solvers committed to a singular idea: reviving the no-boundaries mentality in aerospace. We are a team of the nation’s best, regardless of where we live.

The Electrical Systems Engineer will serve as a technical leader for high‑reliability digital power conversion and electric drive systems, spanning architecture, detailed design, verification, and validation of Thermal Management Systems. This role focuses on developing and qualifying TMS control systems, advanced DC/DC conversion hardware and controls for aerospace applications, including high‑voltage power conversion, motor drive systems, and associated protection, monitoring, and control circuitry. The systems engineer will drive cross‑functional integration across systems, hardware, test, and manufacturing teams, ensuring safe, robust, and compliant solutions that meet customer requirements for safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

While providing Thermal Management Systems requirements support, collaborating with mechanical and systems engineering teams to ensure integrated electrical and thermal solutions for high‑reliability aerospace hardware is a paramount function to this position.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

- Own system‑level requirements flow‑down for digital power conversion hardware, decomposing customer and system requirements into clear, testable hardware and firmware requirements, and ensuring traceability throughout the design lifecycle.
- Document and communicate design decisions, analyses, and test outcomes through formal reports and technical reviews, ensuring traceability and a strong customer‑driven focus.
- Lead architecture and detailed design of digital power conversion, including DC/DC stages, gate drives, protection circuits, sensing chains, and control electronics, with emphasis on high‑voltage and high‑power aerospace applications.
- Plan and execute verification and validation of digital power conversion hardware and systems, including procedure authorship, lab setup, and execution of environmental, functional, and performance tests (e.g., DO160/MIL-STD-461/MIL-STD-704‑type conditions, thermal, vibration, electrical stress).
- Define and validate insulation coordination and HV design rules, including creepage/clearance and high‑voltage practices for converters and drive systems operating at several kilovolts, to meet aerospace safety and reliability expectations.
- Design and Review PCBs and schematics for power stages, gate drivers, control boards, and sensing modules using industry‑standard tools (e.g., Mentor Graphics, Altium), collaborating with layout, mechanical, and systems teams to ensure robust, manufacturable designs.
- Lead high‑voltage testing and qualification activities, including partial discharge (corona) tests and insulation tests at altitude and ground level, using results to drive design improvements and ensure long‑term reliability.
- Work with AI&T to develop and improve automated test benches and lab infrastructure for digital power testing, including scripting and automation where appropriate, and act as a champion for lab safety, structured test procedures, and safe operation at high voltage and high power.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to early career engineers and peers in power converter design, HV test, and system integration, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, structured problem solving, and respect for people
- Contribute to proposals, trade studies, and technology roadmaps for TMS control systems, digital power systems, including evaluation of new topologies, devices, and architectures.

Required Minimum Qualifications:

- Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Electrical Engineering or related discipline with emphasis in power electronics, power conversion, or electric drives.
- Significant experience (e.g., 15+ years) in electrical engineering and electrical systems engineering with focus on power electronics, digital power conversion, and/or electric drive systems, and controls hardware for aerospace or similarly demanding applications.
- Proven experience leading the design, verification, and validation of power conversion hardware (DC/DC, AC/DC, DC/AC) and associated control electronics.
- Experience with high‑voltage systems, insulation coordination, and HV testing and qualification activities.
- Demonstrated ability to work across cross‑functional technical teams and manage technical scope, schedule, and risk.

Desired Characteristics & Experience:

- Strong background in electrical systems engineering, requirements decomposition, and PCB/schematic design for power and control boards (gate drivers, sensors, DSP/control boards, HVDC filters, EMI filters), including DO160/MIL-STD-461/MIL-STD-704‑aware design practices and integration with system‑level requirements.
- Demonstrated technical leadership in complex aerospace programs and coordination of cross‑functional teams, with clear alignment to GE Aerospace Behaviors (Respect for People, Continuous Improvement, Customer Driven).
- Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools for power electronics (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, LTSpice, PSIM, PSCAD) and experience using them to guide design and test.
- Proficient use of IBM DOORS and familiarity with MBSE tools
- Familiarity with JIRA and Confluence
- Experience designing and validating high‑voltage, high‑power conversion systems (e.g., up to several kilovolts) for aerospace, including insulation coordination and partial discharge considerations.
- Hands‑on HV lab experience, including oscilloscopes, power analyzers, HV test setups, and automated test benches, with a demonstrated commitment to lab safety and structured test procedures.

Additional Information:

- Up to 10% travel is required.

postings.description:
Job Description Summary
This is a hands-on technical role supporting the testing, troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex electronic and electro-mechanical avionics hardware in a production and MRO environment. The position focuses on bench-level execution, using established procedures and technical documentation—not engineering design or software development.

This role is ideal for experienced electronics or avionics technicians who enjoy working directly with hardware, supporting production flow, and solving complex technical issues on the shop floor.

Job Description

At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. As part of our Clearwater team, you will support advanced avionics systems used on commercial and military aircraft, including the Boeing 737/787 and platforms such as the F‑18, F‑35, Harrier, and Apache.

You’ll work in a climate-controlled, OSHA VPP Star-certified facility alongside skilled technicians, manufacturing engineers, and test engineers to keep production and repair operations running safely, efficiently, and at the highest quality standards.

This is a technician career path role, offering long-term growth opportunities within operations, technical leadership, and training.

Essential Responsibilities

As a Senior Electronics / Avionics Technician, you will:

- Perform hands-on setup, testing, troubleshooting, repair, and overhaul of complex electronic and electro-mechanical equipment.

- Execute testing using established procedures, schematics, and technical documentation, including Engineering, Manufacturing, and Component Maintenance Manuals.

- Conduct functional, vibration, and thermal cycle testing (based on assignment).

- Troubleshoot equipment at the component and system level using schematics and diagnostic tools.

- Test, calibrate, adjust, and maintain measuring and indicating instruments to defined standards.

- Monitor process performance and product quality, responding quickly to production or repair issues.

- Adjust approved process parameters (within engineering guidelines) to maintain quality and prevent downtime.

- Partner with Manufacturing and Test Engineers to communicate observed issues, trends, and “watch items.”

- Train and support junior technicians as assigned.

- Follow all safety, quality, and regulatory requirements in a high-reliability aerospace environment.

Note: This role is focused on execution and technical support. It does not include product design, software development, or engineering ownership.

Required Qualifications

- High School Diploma or GED

- 2-year technical degree/certificate in Electronics, Avionics, Electro-Mechanical Technology, or similar
OR 2+ years of equivalent hands-on industry experience

- Ability to read and interpret schematics, drawings, and technical procedures

- Comfortable working with electronic test equipment and physical hardware

- Ability to lift/move up to 35 pounds

- Willingness to work overtime or shift schedules as required

- This role may encounter high risk or hazardous operations and/or include working shifts beyond a standard workweek. As such, a requirement of the role is to be at least 18 years of age by the time of joining.

Desired Skills & Experience

- 6+ years of hands-on experience as an electronics, avionics, or electro-mechanical technician

- Experience supporting production, manufacturing, MRO, or repair environments

- Familiarity with aerospace, defense, or regulated industries (preferred)

- Comfortable using a PC to access documentation, drawings, and instructions

- Strong team skills and willingness to mentor less-experienced technicians

Are you an Embedded Software Engineer who loves working on high-assurance embedded systems? If so, GE Aerospace Defense and Systems wants you to join their Advanced Technologies team in Grand Rapids, MI. You will be part of a cross-functional team that develops innovative solutions for capabilities on custom hardware. You will work on projects related to stores management, cybersecurity, networking, and sensing and signal processing.

This position is based in Grand Rapids MI. An extensive corporate relocation package is available for eligible candidates.

GE Aerospace is a leader in inventing the future of flight. GE offers competitive salaries and a full range of benefits, including 401K contributions and matching, flexible work arrangements, generous time off, tuition reimbursement, and various health insurance options.

If you are interested in this exciting opportunity, please apply today!

Job Description

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will play a vital role working with our customers to architect, design, develop, and test Embedded Software (Firmware), platforms and systems for our mission-critical technologies and products. You will work with a team of passionate and skilled engineers who share your vision of creating innovative and reliable embedded systems. To succeed in this position, you will need a background in embedded systems, a keen eye for detail, and a deep understanding of real-time systems and their constraints. You will also need to demonstrate your ability to take full ownership of your role and deliver high-quality software solutions.

Responsibilities:

- Engage with customers and communicate with stakeholders to plan software functionality based on customer needs and constraints.

- Define and formalize system, hardware, software, and human integration requirements.
- Define and execute engineering test, validation, and verification activities.
- Follow established software development methodologies and principles and document your tasks and designs.
- Validate and verify software designs in a diversity of system integration environments – from local desktop computer simulations to fully representative flight tests.
- Implement protocols and algorithms for resource-constrained environments and collaborate with the hardware team to enable communication between modules and applications.
- Ensure software robustness, resilience, and fail-safe operation for critical devices, and mitigate potential safety and security vulnerabilities.
- Create detailed design and technical documentation, optimize existing applications, and implement new features.
- Participate in task prioritization, execution, requirements, specifications, code and design reviews, and mentorship across the software development life cycle.
- Apply best practices for software engineering and understand the key business drivers and product roadmap.
- Deliver your work to support project scope, cost, and schedule targets, and interface effectively with all levels of the organization and customers.
- Propose novel solutions to technical challenges, generate cost and time estimates for future bids and programs, and utilize hardware/software to demonstrate capability against customer expectations.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related STEM fields
- 10+ years of embedded product software engineering experience or MS +7 years experience.
- Proficiency in Ada, C, C++, or equivalent languages.
- Experience in networking protocol development, with experience in detailed design and/or implementing protocols in embedded software/firmware.

- This role requires the successful candidate to maintain a US Government Security Clearance; prerequisite for a security clearance is U.S. Citizenship. Preference will be given to candidates who currently hold US Government Security Clearance.

Desired Qualifications:

- Master's degree in engineering or computer science with extensive experience in C/C++ for embedded software design, development, and testing.
- Knowledge of scripting languages (Python, Perl, Tcl, etc.) and code management tools (Git, CVS, SVN, Perforce, etc.)
- Proficiency in Ada language experience.
- Experience with RTOS (Linux, FreeRTOS, QNX, VxWorks, etc.) and device drivers for complex systems using parallel processing, multi-threading, distributed processing, multi-core, SoM, signal processing, board support package (BSP), device driver development, and / or application program interface (API) design.
- Experience designing and implementing the following networking protocols: Internet Protocol version 4 (IPv4)I, Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6), Address Resolution Protocol (ARP), Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP), Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP), Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP), Transmission Control Protocol (TCP), User Datagram Protocol (UDP), Network Time Protocol (NTP).
- Experience implementing and integrating Internet Protocol Security (IPsec) and Internet Key Exchange (IKE) (version 1 and/or version 2).
- Experience with embedded software testing, debugging, and integration on hardware using debuggers (gdb, lldb, etc.), test equipment (scopes, analyzers, multi-meters, etc.), and UARTs, JTAGs and oscilloscopes.
- Experience working in mission-critical industries (aerospace, automotive, defense, first responder, medical devices, etc.) and turning CONOPS, Specifications or Requirements into software design, code, test plans and execution.

Job Description Summary
The Senior Embedded Software Product Line Leader will lead Platform Software engineering efforts for key programs within the Application Compute Environment (ACE) Product Line. This role serves as the primary engineering interface for customers and internal stakeholders, driving execution across complex embedded software development programs while ensuring alignment on technical, programmatic, and business objectives.

This leader will combine product line ownership, project execution, and technical leadership to guide internal software teams and global suppliers through the full embedded software lifecycle, including development, integration, verification, and DO-178C certification. The role requires strong experience in program execution, cross-functional collaboration, and reusable product line strategy in a highly regulated aerospace environment.

Initially, this position will lead Platform and Test Software efforts for the KC-46 Flight Management Computer (FMC) Refresh and C-130J FMC Refresh programs. With additional military avionics refresh programs expected to follow, a key part of this role will be to shape, mature, and evolve the ACE product line roadmap to enable scalability, reuse, and efficient execution across future programs.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

- Lead distributed software engineering teams across GE Aerospace and external suppliers in the development of Platform Software products.
- Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders across software-related program activities.
- Own and evolve the ACE product line roadmap, ensuring common assets, architecture, and reuse strategies support current and future military refresh programs.
- Drive program execution across schedule, cost, technical scope, risk, and quality commitments.
- Coordinate closely with cross-functional partners including Systems, Hardware, Safety, Security, Quality, Certification, Sourcing, and Program Management.
- Provide technical oversight and leadership across the full software lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, verification, validation, and certification.
- Lead supplier and subcontractor coordination to ensure alignment, execution rigor, and delivery performance.
- Provide regular status, metrics, and risk visibility to leadership and stakeholders.
- Mentor sub-team leads and support development of technical and execution capability across the broader team.
- Partner with engineering managers to define staffing, technology, product reuse, and process improvement strategies.
- Champion continuous improvement and product line engineering practices to improve efficiency, standardization, and long-term platform value.
- Lead adoption of AI-enabled engineering initiatives that enhance software development effectiveness, including opportunities in test automation, defect trend analysis, requirements insights, code quality, verification efficiency, and knowledge reuse.
- Identify and mature opportunities to apply artificial intelligence and digital tools in ways that support engineering productivity while maintaining compliance with aerospace safety, certification, cybersecurity, and quality requirements.
- Foster a forward-looking engineering culture that embraces automation, model-based methods, data-driven decision-making, and responsible AI use in support of next-generation avionics development.
- Partner across the organization to evaluate and scale emerging technologies that improve product line reuse, speed of execution, and engineering excellence.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university or college.

- Minimum of 10 years of experience leading software engineering execution through the full development lifecycle.
- Demonstrated experience managing complex technical projects involving cross-functional and multi-site teams.
- Strong experience providing technical leadership in embedded software environments.
- Ability to work effectively with customers, internal stakeholders, and suppliers in a highly regulated development setting.
- Demonstrated ability to lead technology transformation, process improvement, or digital engineering initiatives within engineering organizations.

- Experience managing complex technical projects involving cross-functional and multi-site teams.

- Ability to work effectively with customers, internal stakeholders, and suppliers in a regulated development environment.

Working closely with the IT Project Manager, this person will manage the full site implementation from planning through go-live, making sure the project stays on schedule, on budget, and minimizes disruption to production.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience delivering MES, ERP, or similar manufacturing system projects in live industrial environments, with the ability to manage risk, coordinate suppliers, and lead cross-functional teams across operations, engineering, quality, IT/OT, and maintenance.

Experience in aerospace manufacturing or other highly regulated industry would be a strong advantage.

*Please note* This is a two year fixed term contract.

Program & Delivery Management

- Lead the full lifecycle of the site MES project from planning and requirements through design, build, test, deployment, and stabilisation.
- Develop and maintain an integrated site-level schedule covering process design, system configuration, infrastructure, data readiness, testing, training, cutover, and change management.

We develop technologies to enable high‑mix low-volume work cell that operate independently and alongside human teammates without bespoke retooling.  We also create autonomous solutions for uncrewed and reduced‑crew vehicles spanning sensing, localization, navigation, mission planning, and execution.

As a Senior Robotics & Autonomy Engineer, you will invent, prototype, and mature embodied AI and autonomy from TRL 1-6, transitioning capabilities into GE Aerospace programs and products. You will partner with senior leadership across the enterprise to shape roadmaps, lead multidisciplinary teams, originate and propose new projects, and collaborate with external partners in academia, industry, and government agencies.

Your research will enable adaptive systems that operate in the physical world within defined safety envelopes, unlocking:

High-mix low-volume manufacturing automation capabilities applicable to diverse tasks without requiring bespoke hardware and software development.

Mission autonomy across a wide range of applications from detection and localization of cargo for pickup to complex detect-and-avoid systems to prevent near miss conditions when unresponsive or uncooperative objects enter controlled airspace.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

- Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams in delivering autonomy solutions for manufacturing and vehicle/mission autonomy.

- Invent, prototype, and mature embodied AI and autonomy from TRL 2–6, spanning robotic cell design, sensing and perception, controls and planning, and behavior or policy learning.

- Build high-quality, scalable software using modern tools and practices, creating reusable autonomy and robotics components.

- Collaborate with GE Aerospace programs and product teams to align research with business needs and transition technologies beyond GE Aerospace Research.

- Shape the autonomy strategy by working with other Autonomous Systems experts across GE Aerospace and external partners.

- Communicate research outcomes via publications, internal reviews, and demos; represent the lab to customers, collaborators, and leadership.

- Create and protect intellectual property through invention disclosures and patents.

- Grow as a technical and thought leader, positioning for future roles such as Principal Scientist or technical manager.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- PhD with 5+ years, MS with 7+ years, BS with 10+ years in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or related field focused on robotic or vehicle autonomy.

- 4+ years of commercial or industrial experience, preferably applying autonomy or robotics to real-world systems.

- Strong rapid prototyping skills for robust, efficient, scalable software.

- Strong grounding in robotics theory (e.g., kinematics, dynamics, control, planning, perception) and interest in applying it to real-time physical AI systems.

- Willing to travel at least 2 weeks per year for collaboration, testing, and reviews.

- Due to the nature of the duties of this position, this role requires the individual to have the ability to obtain and maintain US Government Security Clearance; prerequisite for a security clearance is U.S. citizenship.

- Willing to relocate to work out of an office located in Niskayuna, NY

- Application must be submitted via www.gecareers.com  to be considered.

Ideal Candidate Characteristics:

- PhD in Robotics, Mechatronics, or Autonomous Systems, especially embodied AI or uncrewed aerial systems.

- Expertise in at least one area: vehicle autonomy, mission autonomy, high-mix robot autonomy, robotic manufacturing automation, human-machine teaming, or human-robot interaction.

- Proficiency in C/C++ for edge or real-time systems.

- Experience with the Robot Operating System (ROS)

- Experience winning or executing externally funded research, including proposals and collaboration with agencies such as DARPA, ARL, AFRL, or ONR.

- Postdoctoral or industrial experience inventing and advancing new autonomous systems technologies.

- Strong track record of peer-reviewed publications in autonomy, robotics, or related application domains.

- Visible impact in the technical community, e.g., open-source contributions or a strong GitHub portfolio.

- Hands-on experience with industrial robotic arms or high-mix robotic workcells.

postings.location: Rutland, Vermont, United States of America
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
The Lean Site Leader will demonstrate knowledge and execution of lean, six sigma and process improvement concepts, approaches and methodologies. You will work directly with the site staff in the development and implementation of FLIGHT DECK/lean strategies in identified areas, specifically, transformation programs in each business unit). In the designated area(s).

In this role, you will focus on projects / process improvement to ensure that products are manufactured with the appropriate safety, quality, delivery, cost (SQDC) hierarchy.

FLIGHT DECK is GE Aerospace’s lean operating model which consists of behaviors and fundamentals incorporating results management and lean principles to create a culture that is focused on creating value for our customers through respect for people. FLIGHT DECK is how we fulfill our mission to invent the future of flight, lift people up, and bring them home safely.

Relocation assistance is an offered benefit for this position.

Job Description

- Drive lean manufacturing activities through the evolution of the GE production system at all levels of the organization
- Demonstrate Leadership in communicating business goals, programs, and processes for identified model business unit(s)/areas
- Utilize experience or expertise to solve problems, develop and execute objectives for self and others, and have the ability to effect short and some long-term goals
- Act as a change agent in the implementation of demand flow utilizing lean manufacturing tools and methodologies
- Establish and implement strategies, programs and practices to achieve lean business system adoption at the facility
- Manage the full implementation of the lean management system including strategy, value stream activities, daily management, and architecture/infrastructure
- Manage multiple Lean Leaders (gemba coaches) and lean support team (lean generalists) to drive best practices in process design and implementation of the lean business system
- Manage the sitewide training team and Training Operations Manager to ensure alignment with lean transformation efforts as well as training compliance. This includes curriculum development and delivery and audit readiness.
- Advise and coach site leadership and their teams on the lean business system
- Assessing and addressing gaps through course development and delivery.
- Create, with site staff, the lean vision and implement the lean strategy to assist the operation in its lean transformation
- Drive measurable improvements within the business
- Sensei/Coach gemba coaches on the facilitation of week-long kaizen events that are aligned with the achievement of business site level metrics.
- Champion change across the organization to foster the growth in Lean and site teaming journey
- Help define and manage investment and expense needs that are in line with Growth Playbook Strategy
- Help drive engagement with site business leaders to collaborate in Lean initiatives that foster goal attainment for current and future business needs
- Lead multiple projects driven from team engagement and site priorities
- Bring new ideas, motivation and positive support to all levels of the team
- Lead and effectively interface with manufacturing and other support teams to complete projects to meet EHS, production, quality, inventory and cost savings
- Interface with vendors/OEM's and internal contacts in an effective manner to ensure that technology and processes are positioned for current and future success

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree from accredited college or university (or a high school diploma / GED with at least 4 years of experience in lean manufacturing leadership experience)
- At least an additional 5 years of lean manufacturing leadership experience

- 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, quality improvement, and people leadership and 5+ years of experience in lean/FLIGHT DECK or operations leadership utilizing lean methodologies
- Experience driving improvement strategies while coaching leaders through problem solving techniques
- Corporate Training Program graduate (Manufacturing / Operations / Engineering)
- Experience analyzing problems, identifying root causes and providing efficient solutions
- Ability to handle diverse activities simultaneously and work in a matrix organization
- Ability to facilitate across all levels of the organization
- Ability to communicate effectively and contribute to team projects
- Strong project and team leadership experience
- Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn
- Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively
- Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed

postings.title: SMS Risk Focal on Site
postings.location: Pomigliano D'Arco, Napoli, Italy
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
At Avio Aero, a GE Aerospace company, we invent the future of flight, lift people up, and bring them home safely. We are a world-leading provider specializing in the design, production, and maintenance of components and propulsion systems for both civil and military aviation. Respect for people is core to our culture and commitment to FLIGHT DECK, our proprietary lean operating model. We attract, develop, and retain industry-leading talent from all backgrounds and cultivate communities where people are respected and empowered to reach their fullest potential. For the people of GE Aerospace, their work isn't just a job. It's their passion and purpose. We work and win as one team, accountable to each other and our customers, and we are always finding a better way to climb higher together. We were meant to fly.

As SMS Risk Focal on Site you will be responsible for managing hazards within the assigned plant and serving as a key liaison among Compliance, Supply Chain, Product Quality, Operations, and SMS.
Working in close partnership with cross-functional teams, you will lead investigations and the hazard management process from a Safety Risk perspective, supporting teams in defining actions required to ensure residual risk acceptability in accordance with company procedures.
You will also coordinate mitigation activities, maintain hazard records and support the organization in strengthening its Safety Management System (SMS), safety culture, and compliance readiness. In addition, you will participate in operational rhythms to help identify threats, hazards, and potential risk consequences related to products, services, and systems.
This role reports directly to the Safety Risk Management Leader.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

- Manage and update the hazard log and SAT records with accuracy and discipline
- Support cross-functional collaboration to ensure effective hazard read-across across processes, products, and organizations
- Lead preliminary investigations engaging risk owners, by gathering data, facts, and supporting evidence
- Collect and review reports, inputs, and operational signals related to potential safety hazards
- Evaluate incoming information and record identified hazards in the hazard log, including classification and traceability
- Support preliminary work preparation and present hazard cases to the Safety Action Team (SAT) for formal risk assessment
- Coordinate, track, and monitor risk mitigation action plans, including escalation when required
- Apply FLIGHT DECK standards in daily management and operational routines
- Support the SMS team with trend analysis, safety metrics, safety culture initiatives, and customer/regulatory audits
- Actively participate in daily shop floor operating rhythms to foster strong cross-functional collaboration and engagement

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in a technical discipline
- Previous experience in the aerospace and defense organizations, in one or more of the following areas: Engineering, Manufacturing, Product Quality, Safety, Quality Management Systems
- Knowledge of aviation regulations and standards
- Knowledge of problem-solving and LEAN methodologies
- Strong inspection and investigation capability
- Understanding of management systems, including compliance monitoring systems
- Understanding of risk analysis and assessment methodologies
- Understanding of Safety Management Systems (SMS) and Human Factors
- Fluent Italian and English
- Work Visa, in accordance with local regulation, is required

Desired Qualifications:

- Pragmatic, fact-based decision-making
- Ability to identify weak signals and emerging safety risks
- Systems thinking and cross-functional perspective
- Strong prioritization and decision-making skills
- High attention to detail, traceability, and record quality
- Facilitation skills to drive alignment across functions
- Resilience and independence under operational pressure
- Sensitivity to human and organizational factors
- Experience in quality assurance and auditing
- Effective communication skills
- Flexibility and adaptability in role execution

Why Join Us:

At Avio Aero, people power our progress. That’s why we invest in an environment where you can develop professionally, feel valued personally, and enjoy a healthy balance between work and life. As part of the CCNL Metalmeccanico framework, you’ll benefit from a comprehensive package designed to support you and your family, including:

- Performance-related bonuses and local bonus scheme

- Flexible benefits platform with company contributions

- Employee pension plan with company contribution

- Life and accident insurance

- Private complementary medical coverage

- Sponsored canteen or meal vouchers where no canteen is available

- Global wellbeing program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional wellbeing including Employee Assistance Program

- Recognition awards to celebrate service and achievements
- Local special agreements, discounts and special offers

- English and languages training for you and one member of your family

- Ongoing technical, leadership, and development training to help you build your career

Contract Level: CCNL metalmeccanico – B3

Salary range for this role: 48.300,00 - 72.450,00 EUR Annual + Performance-related bonus + PDR up to 6000 euro
Compensation will be defined within the published salary range, reflecting the candidate’s experience, developed skills, and overall alignment with the role’s responsibilities.

Join us!
Avio Aero is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a culture of respect, where every individual is valued, supported, and empowered to thrive. Employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. Join us and be part of a team where your talent, ideas, and ambition can help shape the future of flight. Apply now and see your career take flight!

This position operates Surface Mount Technology (SMT) electronics manufacturing equipment used to produce circuit card assemblies.

Job Description

At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies, and we lead in the development and manufacture of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. Joining our collaborative and diverse team means bringing your unique perspectives, innovative spirit, and drive to a people-first organization that values your ideas and supports your growth through our ongoing LEAN transformation. Your work will have a meaningful impact on millions of lives, and you will share in our sense of purpose and pride as we advance aviation technologies for today and tomorrow.

- Career Growth: GE isn’t just a great place to start your career—it’s a great place to expand and grow your career. Many entry-level employees grow into leadership roles in operations or other parts of the business. There are also opportunities to continue your career at GE in Clearwater or across the globe.

postings.title: Software Engineer AI/ML
postings.location: Evendale, Ohio, United States of America
postings.additional_locations: Remote, United States of America
postings.description:
Job Description Summary
The CES Business Intelligence team is building the next generation of AI-powered solutions for commercial, contracts, and operations. We're looking for an AI Engineer to help transform GE Aerospace operational data into production-grade machine learning pipelines, models, and LLM-powered applications.

This is a multi-faceted engineering role. You'll spend most of your time developing AI/ML products by training models, developing applications, and creating APIs. You will partner closely with analytics teams to enable AI within our existing operational tools. You'll also contribute to AI strategy and partner with executive stakeholders to align on requirements, success metrics, and business impact. We're looking for someone who's excited to expand their technical skillset in AI/ML and deliver advanced solutions that directly impact daily operations.

What you'll do: Design, build, deliver, and maintain AI/ML products including LLM-powered applications, forecasting models, anomaly detection systems, and intelligent agents. Own the full AI/ML lifecycle: requirements analysis, model design, training, evaluation, API development, deployment, and operational support. Convert complex operational datasets into scalable AI capabilities that enable real-time decision support.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

AI/ML Product Development

- Define, build, and evolve AI-powered software products that accelerate Commercial Engine Services operations—including LLM applications, machine learning models, and intelligent automation for supply chain optimization
- Create Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that package domain-specific AI capabilities for reuse across the enterprise.
- Package AI/ML models as robust, well-documented APIs that enable seamless integration into dashboards, applications, and operational workflows.
- Collaborate with BI team to embed AI features into existing applications that enable natural language queries, predictive insights, and intelligent recommendations directly within user-facing applications

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Provide hands-on AI/ML technical leadership for our modernization initiative, setting best practices for prompt engineering, model evaluation, experiment tracking, and responsible AI development
- Partner with executive stakeholders and BI leadership to understand business challenges and translate operational needs into AI/ML capabilities
- Ensure AI/ML models deploy reliably to AWS infrastructure with proper monitoring, logging, and performance optimization
- Translate requirements into a prioritized backlog of AI/ML products, driving delivery to required timelines, quality standards, and measurable business outcomes
- Collaborate with data platform teams to design data pipelines that feed AI/ML models to ensure data quality, freshness, and proper feature engineering from the Databricks medallion architecture

AI/ML Infrastructure & MLOps

- Establish MLOps practices including experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases), model versioning, automated evaluation pipelines, and A/B testing frameworks for continuous model improvement
- Drive world-class quality through rigorous SDLC practices: Lean/Agile/XP, CI/CD, automated testing, secure coding, scalability patterns, documentation-as-code, refactoring, and performance engineering
- Implement monitoring and observability for AI/ML systems to track model performance, data drift, prediction latency, and error rates; build automated alerting for model degradation
- Design vector database architectures and semantic search capabilities to power RAG applications; optimize retrieval strategies for accuracy and latency
- Build evaluation frameworks for LLM applications—measuring response quality, accuracy, relevance, and hallucination rates; establish automated testing for prompt templates and model outputs
- Ensure responsible AI practices including bias detection, explainability (SHAP, LIME), privacy-preserving techniques, and compliance with enterprise AI governance policies

Innovation & Strategy

- Drive the AI/ML roadmap for Commercial Engine Services BI team by identifying high-impact use cases, evaluating emerging AI technologies, and building proof-of-concepts that demonstrate business value
- Stay current on LLM advancements, ML frameworks, vector databases, and AI application patterns; bring practical innovations that improve decision speed and operational outcomes
- Engage domain experts to ensure successful transfer of complex operational knowledge into AI models and intelligent systems
- Establish reusable AI/ML components, templates, and reference architectures that accelerate future development and enable the BI team to leverage AI capabilities independently
- Communicate AI/ML concepts, tradeoffs, and results to non-technical stakeholders through clear documentation, executive presentations, and live demonstrations

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related field from an accredited college or university
- Minimum of 3 years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience building and deploying machine learning models and/or AI-powered applications to production

Desired Characteristics

Technical Expertise

- Write production-quality code that meets standards and delivers intended functionality using the most appropriate technologies for the project (e.g., Python, Java, C#, TypeScript—based on system needs)
- Proven experience building data platforms and production LLM-powered applications; strong understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector databases
- Strong foundation in supervised/unsupervised learning, time-series forecasting, classification, and optimization
- Experience with MLflow, model registries, automated training pipelines, A/B testing frameworks, and model monitoring; strong DevOps collaboration skills
- Expertise in development platforms and services: AWS, Visual Studio, Databricks, GitHub, etc.
- Experience building REST APIs (FastAPI, Flask) for model serving; understanding of authentication, rate limiting, versioning, and API documentation

Domain & Business Acumen

- Experience building AI/ML solutions for supply chain, manufacturing, maintenance, or operations analytics is a strong plus
- Understands business metrics and can translate AI/ML capabilities into quantifiable business outcomes (cost savings, time reduction, forecast accuracy improvement)
- Skilled in breaking down ambiguous AI problems, writing clear problem statements, and estimating model development effort accurately
- Stays current on AI/ML industry trends (LLM advancements, new frameworks, emerging techniques); brings practical innovations backed by proof-of-concepts

Leadership & Collaboration

- Leads by example through delivering AI/ML products while mentoring team on AI integration, prompt engineering, and model usage
- Able to work through ambiguity and drive alignment between AI capabilities and business needs; communicates model limitations, confidence intervals, and uncertainty clearly to non-technical stakeholders
- Continuously measures solutions against user expectations while balancing competing priorities and maintaining build quality.

Personal Attributes

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts simply and translate effectively between data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders
- Effective collaborator who works seamlessly with BI developers, platform engineers, and business stakeholders
- Business-minded approach that focuses on operational metrics, user needs, and business impact while designing AI solutions that solve real problems rather than technical exercises
- Persists to completion by driving AI/ML products through deployment, monitoring, and iteration while taking ownership of model performance and continuously improving accuracy

The base pay range for this position is $112,000-150,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on August 14th, 2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.

At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Job Description Summary

Job Description

Jako Specjalista/ka ds. Planowania i Gotowości Produkcyjnej będziesz odgrywać kluczową rolę w zapewnieniu gotowości operacyjnej w ścisłej współpracy z klientem. W tej roli skoncentrujesz się na rozumieniu i przewidywaniu bieżących oraz przyszłych potrzeb klienta, reagowaniu na ich zmienność oraz inicjowaniu i wdrażaniu zmian w firmie zgodnie z tymi oczekiwaniami. Współpracując zarówno z zespołami wewnętrznymi, jak
i zewnętrznymi, będziesz nie tylko zwiększać zdolności produkcyjne, ale także kształtować sposób, w jaki dostarczamy wartość klientowi.
Twoje działania będą miały bezpośredni wpływ na realizację globalnych celów w perspektywie 3-letniej, wspierając naszą organizację w osiąganiu najwyższych standardów bezpieczeństwa, jakości, dostaw i kosztów (SQDC).

Twój zakres obowiązków:

- Zapewnienie gotowości operacyjnej z perspektywy klienta - analiza procesów, zasobów i systemów pod kątem ich zdolności do realizacji bieżących i przyszłych potrzeb klienta oraz identyfikacja ryzyk i luk w przygotowaniu oraz proponowanie działań korygujących.
- Pełnienie roli kluczowego punktu kontaktu dla klienta w organizacji - budowanie i utrzymywanie pozytywnych, partnerskich relacji z klientem, regularny kontakt, zbieranie i doprecyzowywanie wymagań oraz tłumaczenie ich na konkretne działania wewnątrz firmy.
- Koordynacja działań przygotowawczych, obejmująca współpracę z zespołami centralnymi i działem zakupów, tworzenie planów działań
i harmonogramów w celu zapewnienia odpowiedniego przygotowania.
- Wspieranie procesów planowania sprzedaży i operacji (S&OP).
- Budowanie pozytywnych relacji z zespołem wewnętrznym.
- Monitorowanie postępów, czyli śledzenie realizacji działań, raportowanie wyników i zapewnienie zgodności z wymaganiami SQDC.
- Zarządzanie ryzykiem zorientowanym na klienta - identyfikacja ryzyk mogących wpłynąć na realizację zamówień lub satysfakcję klienta, proponowanie działań zapobiegawczych i naprawczych oraz koordynacja ich wdrożenia.
- Opracowanie kluczowych wskaźników efektywności (KPI) i standardów pracy.
- Wsparcie w procesach wdrożeniowych, w tym udział w testach, szkoleniach i działaniach związanych z wdrożeniem nowych rozwiązań.
- Raportowanie wyników swojej pracy.

- Minimum 3 letnie doświadczenie w obszarze łańcucha dostaw, operacji, zarządzania projektami, we współpracy z klientem oraz w realizacji jego wymagań.
- Wykształcenie wyższe (preferowane w dziedzinie zarządzania, logistyki lub pokrewne).
- Znajomość narzędzi analitycznych np. Excel, Power BI.
- Umiejętność pracy z dużą ilością danych i koordynacji zadań z różnych źródeł.
- Myślenie analityczne, krytyczne podejście do procesów, kreatywność.
- Umiejętności rozwiązywania problemów, podejmowania decyzji, organizacji pracy w środowisku o zmiennych priorytetach klienta
- Wysokie zdolności komunikacyjne i negocjacyjne, nastawienie na budowanie partnerskich relacji z klientem oraz skuteczną współprace
z zespołami wewnętrznymi.
- Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (min. B2) oraz znajomość języka polskiego na poziomie swobodnej komunikacji.

postings.description:
Job Description Summary
The Senior Data Engineer designs and builds the AWS-native data foundation behind our enterprise AI applications — knowledge graphs, semantic layers, retrieval corpora, and the pipelines that keep them trustworthy. This role leads both the design strategy for how our AI systems understand enterprise data and the hands-on engineering to make it real. You will set the patterns the rest of the team — including citizen developers building with Agents and MCPs — follow when they access, curate, or extend our data.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

Knowledge Graph and Semantic Layer (primary focus)

- Lead the design and evolution of the knowledge graphs and ontologies powering our AI's reasoning, retrieval, and explainability.
- Align enterprise data (engineering handbooks, parts, service manuals, DMAIC records, user files) into a coherent, queryable graph with clear provenance across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources.
- Own the retrieval substrate — graph queries, vector indexes, and hybrid retrieval — and drive measurable improvements in grounding quality.

AI/ML Data Quality

- Curate grounding corpora, eval datasets, and retrieval benchmarks for LLM-based features.
- Instrument metrics for retrieval quality, grounding accuracy, and freshness; drive regressions down over time.
- Shape training and inference data contracts with AI engineers, including feedback loops from user signals.

Data Modeling and Pipelines on AWS

- Produce conceptual, logical, and physical data models for operational and analytical workloads; establish modeling standards, naming conventions, and reuse patterns.
- Build ingestion and transformation pipelines in Python and SQL using AWS services — Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, Athena, OpenSearch, Neptune — and AI services such as Bedrock and Bedrock Knowledge Bases.
- Author infrastructure as code in CloudFormation (CDK welcome) and apply AWS best practices for IAM, security, cost, and observability.
- Profile sources, identify data quality gaps, and design automated validation, monitoring, metadata, and lineage.

Data Governance and Identity Integration

- Partner with security and platform teams to integrate data access with enterprise identity and access policies, as we look to modernize for AI.
- Define data contracts, attributes, and metadata that policy engines can reason over for attribute- and context-based access control.
- Contribute to the technical data dictionary, business glossary, and data catalog.

Technical Leadership

- Set the design direction for data and semantic modeling across the team.
- Mentor engineers and citizen developers on modeling, ontology design, and retrieval engineering.
- Communicate tradeoffs and value clearly to product, business, and executive stakeholders

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a STEM field
- A minimum of three years of data engineering experience

Eligibility Requirement:

- Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

Desired Qualifications:

- 5+ years of hands-on data engineering with a track record of designing — not just implementing — data models and semantic layers.
- Production experience with knowledge graphs and ontologies (Neo4j, Neptune, TigerGraph, RDF/SPARQL, or similar) and graph query languages (Cypher, Gremlin, SPARQL).
- Strong AWS proficiency required: CloudFormation (or CDK), Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, Bedrock, Bedrock Knowledge Bases; OpenSearch and Neptune a plus.
- Strong Python and SQL; comfort across relational, graph, vector, and document stores.
- Experience supporting AI/ML or LLM systems — RAG pipelines, embeddings, eval datasets, grounding corpora.
- Experience integrating data access with enterprise identity and policy systems
- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication, including technical presentations to non-data audiences.

Leadership Skills:

- Ability to work effectively with multi-disciplinary teams (e.g., Digital Technology, GE Business teams) and understand the inter-dependencies between them.
- Ability to showcase teamwork skills to achieve common goals, provide resolutions and share ideas.
- Demonstrate the presentation and influencing skills

The base pay range for this position is $110,00-145,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on September 18th, 2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. As a member of the Avionics Business Capture team, the Sr Sales Director will lead sales and business development efforts for GE Aerospace's Avionics business segment with a primary focus on military markets and OEM customers.

The dynamic and growing Avionics business provides cutting-edge solutions, including networked computing, data transfer systems, controls and displays, flight management systems, health management, stores management, cockpit and data recorders, and a comprehensive suite of other Avionics capabilities in both commercial and military space.

In this role, the Sr Sales Director will identify growth opportunities and lead capture campaigns to win new Original Equipment business across military platforms and adjacent markets. This role will primarily focus on Flight Management Systems, Stores Management, Data Transfer, Recorders, and Vehicle Health Management, but may evolve over time based on business needs. This individual contributor role requires a leader capable of shaping requirements early, aligning internal resources with customer needs, and managing complex capture efforts across multiple stakeholders.
